0084148c9296.en: “There you go, Harry! Now let’s get cracking!” A fatherly smile appeared on Itagiba’s face as he herded the stranger, now named Harry, away from the southwest tower he had come from, towards two other identical towers not far away.
0084148c9296.t: “Nah, begitu, Harry! Sekarang ayo kita mulai!” Senyum kebapakan muncul di wajah Itagiba saat ia menggiring orang asing itu, yang kini bernama Harry, menjauh dari southwest tower tempat ia datang, menuju dua menara lain yang identik tak jauh dari situ.

019009103f45.en: “So that’s a toilet?” Harry saw the light coming from the stone completely falter as Sora dumped the water down the toilet.
019009103f45.t: “Jadi itu kloset?” Harry melihat cahaya dari batu itu padam sepenuhnya saat Sora membuang airnya ke kloset.

01ad690e5152.en: “That’s us, bud! Long story, though, and I need to go get your badge ready. Sora, can you put extra soap in the bathwater?” A grin arose on Itagiba, the Sanbi King. “He’s gonna need it.”
01ad690e5152.t: “Itu kita, Bro! Tapi ceritanya panjang, dan aku harus menyiapkan lencanamu. Sora, bisa tambahkan sabun ekstra ke air mandinya?” Seringai muncul di wajah Itagiba, sang Raja Sanbi. “Dia bakal butuh itu.”

0564758476ed.en: His brow furrowed. A strong stench of death mixed with a strong oily musk raped his nose, burning deep like taking a big whiff of bleach; his bronchioles deep within his lungs screamed in agony. With no warning, he suddenly sneezed his brains out, popping their eyes out of their sockets—at least that's what the sensation of pain felt like as no actual brain matter came out, nor did his eyes free themselves.
0564758476ed.t: Dahinya berkerut. Bau kematian yang menyengat bercampur aroma musk berminyak yang kuat memerkosa hidungnya, membakar dalam-dalam seperti menghirup pemutih banyak-banyak; bronkiolus jauh di dalam paru-parunya menjerit kesakitan. Tanpa peringatan, ia tiba-tiba bersin sekeras-kerasnya sampai otaknya serasa keluar, matanya serasa melompat dari rongganya—setidaknya begitulah rasa sakitnya, karena tak ada otak yang benar-benar keluar, dan matanya pun tidak membebaskan diri.

05fe38f53863.en: “It’s a half timehunk, sir.” Sora opened another drawer, and grabbed a round metal object, opened it in half, and pointed it against the window. “Have you ever seen a timekeeper before?”
05fe38f53863.t: “Itu setengah timehunk, Tuan.” Sora membuka laci lain, dan mengambil benda logam bundar, membukanya menjadi dua, lalu mengarahkannya ke jendela. “Apakah Anda pernah melihat penunjuk waktu sebelumnya?”

072038900e0b.en: Her cheerfully cyan eyes were like pearls, but those pearly eyes did not dare gaze at him, instead she gazed towards the cityscape in the backdrop of the window beside them. “Hi King! Is this gentleman the new guest?” Her voice was a sweetly feminine voice that sounded like a lullaby—a rap lullaby that she ended with a stiff posture, anxiously waiting for orders.
072038900e0b.t: Matanya yang sian dan ceria bagaikan mutiara, tetapi mata mutiara itu tidak berani menatapnya, malah menatap ke arah pemandangan kota di balik jendela di samping mereka. “Halo, Baginda Raja! Apakah tuan ini tamu yang baru?” Suaranya adalah suara feminin yang manis yang terdengar seperti lagu nina bobo—lagu nina bobo versi rap yang ia akhiri dengan postur kaku, menunggu perintah dengan cemas.

082320fe85df.en: A crunchy sound, followed by an orgasmic hum came out of the lard ass entertaining himself. The taco, filled with carne asada, lettuce, tomatoes, and thick chunks of cheddar, became a single mush of flavor explosion in his mouth, all brought together by chimichurri sauce. But the flavor explosion didn’t last long, for it was quickly sent down his gullet by a refreshing, frizzy light ale that had a slightly bitter and malty taste that gave way into a slightly sweet aftertaste.
082320fe85df.t: Bunyi renyah, disusul gumaman penuh kenikmatan, keluar dari si gendut pemalas yang sedang menghibur dirinya. Taco itu, berisi carne asada, selada, tomat, dan potongan tebal keju cheddar, menjadi satu bubur ledakan rasa di mulutnya, semuanya dipadukan oleh saus chimichurri. Tetapi ledakan rasa itu tidak bertahan lama, karena segera didorong turun ke kerongkongannya oleh light ale berbuih yang menyegarkan, dengan rasa sedikit pahit dan bernuansa malt yang berganti menjadi sisa rasa yang agak manis.

09f013ffb206.en: Ask her to wash your back. Itagiba’s voice came to his mind again, but Harry blew the idea off with a quick head shake. There’s no way I can ask her that.
09f013ffb206.t: Minta dia menggosok punggungmu. Suara Itagiba muncul lagi di benaknya, tetapi Harry menepis gagasan itu dengan gelengan cepat. Tidak mungkin aku bisa memintanya begitu.

0a366c9227e2.en: Tears poured out of his eyes as he felt nothingness taking his last memory away from him. Amidst the tears flowing through his greasy cheeks, a white sparkle of light appeared in the distance, moving randomly, with disregard to the laws of physics, searching for something as if it was a UFO in the sky. One second it was barely the size of a penny, then next it was the size of a car as it zoomed around in the darkness, appearing as if searching for something.
0a366c9227e2.t: Air mata tumpah dari matanya saat ia merasakan kehampaan merenggut ingatan terakhirnya darinya. Di tengah air mata yang mengalir di pipinya yang berminyak, secercah cahaya putih muncul di kejauhan, bergerak secara acak, tak menghiraukan hukum fisika, mencari sesuatu seolah UFO di langit. Satu detik ukurannya nyaris tak lebih besar dari koin, detik berikutnya sebesar mobil saat melesat ke sana kemari dalam kegelapan, tampak seperti sedang mencari sesuatu.

0a4f4b8d9b9b.en: “Don’t step on them or she’s gonna get cranky!” Itagiba warned as he stepped carefully around them.
0a4f4b8d9b9b.t: “Jangan diinjak atau dia bakal ngambek!” Itagiba memperingatkan sambil melangkah hati-hati di sekelilingnya.

0ab14db837a5.en: Feeling violated, the stranger covered his belly button, nervously laughing along with Itagiba. Ehh? That’s weird.
0ab14db837a5.t: Merasa dilecehkan, orang asing itu menutupi pusarnya, tertawa gugup bersama Itagiba. Ehh? Aneh juga.

0ccb1cf8bdba.en: A slightly cold breeze flooded the room, bringing a salty air alongside the noisy rustles of the vibrating city down below. With a large breath of fresh air, Harry felt the stagnant air come out of his lungs. Damm. Those taco farts are still just as bad—wait—didn’t I have my own place too? Harry, looking at the blur of houses in this foreign city, tried to juggle his memory, but the only thing that appeared was a resemblance of a red recliner, and a TV in front of it. What happened to it? Did I lose all my money, then end up in the slums? But then why can't I remember anything? Is that why everything feels so off?
0ccb1cf8bdba.t: Angin yang agak dingin membanjiri ruangan, membawa udara asin bersama riuh kebisingan kota yang bergetar di bawah. Dengan tarikan napas panjang menghirup udara segar, Harry merasakan udara pengap keluar dari paru-parunya. Sialan. Kentut taco itu masih sama parahnya—tunggu—bukannya aku dulu punya tempat tinggal sendiri juga? Harry, memandangi rumah-rumah yang buram di kota asing ini, mencoba mengutak-atik ingatannya, tetapi satu-satunya yang muncul hanyalah bayangan kursi malas merah, dan TV di depannya. Apa yang terjadi dengannya? Apa aku kehilangan semua uangku, lalu berakhir di permukiman kumuh? Tapi kenapa aku tidak ingat apa-apa? Apa itu sebabnya semuanya terasa begitu janggal?

0ec97c84affd.en: An offbeat smile shone on Neferteri, appearing to partake in enjoying this stranger’s misfortune. With a joyous tone, she spoke slowly, “Don’t despair. Please take solace in the fact that we do know some facts about you.”
0ec97c84affd.t: Senyum yang janggal bersinar di wajah Neferteri, tampak ikut menikmati kemalangan orang asing ini. Dengan nada gembira, ia berbicara perlahan, “Jangan putus asa. Silakan terhibur oleh kenyataan bahwa kami mengetahui beberapa fakta tentang Anda.”

0f20b0f36579.en: “A—a race, like the Naked Bruntos, sir?” Sora replied in an inquisitive tone of her own.
0f20b0f36579.t: “S—sebuah ras, seperti Naked Bruntos, Tuan?” jawab Sora dengan nada bertanya juga.

0f39c383bfdb.en: “Oh! I’m sorry!” Harry flipped the lamp upright again, rattling the stones even more.
0f39c383bfdb.t: “Oh! Maaf!” Harry membalik lampu itu tegak lagi, membuat batu-batunya berkelotakan lebih keras.

10ed3829c5cc.en: Harry, huffing as he carefully watched his step, reached the midway point of the second flight of stairs. From the corners of his eyes, he noticed something quickly walking down towards him; gasping amidst inhaling, he saw a girl far cuter than sexy. Her fiery red hair contrasted her black maid clothing with blue accents. Her small mouth had a charming, embarrassed smile, and two cutesy canines poking from below that looked like inverted vampire fangs. Her flushed skin was so visible that it appeared as if she had rosacea.
10ed3829c5cc.t: Harry, terengah-engah sambil memperhatikan langkahnya dengan hati-hati, mencapai titik tengah tangga kedua. Dari sudut matanya, ia melihat sesuatu berjalan cepat turun ke arahnya; tersentak di tengah tarikan napas, ia melihat seorang gadis yang jauh lebih imut daripada seksi. Rambut merahnya yang menyala kontras dengan pakaian pelayan hitamnya yang beraksen biru. Mulut mungilnya menyunggingkan senyum malu yang menawan, dan dua taring imut menyembul dari bawah yang tampak seperti taring vampir terbalik. Kulitnya yang merona begitu kentara sampai tampak seolah ia menderita rosacea.

141d320ad979.en: A hum came out of Harry, his hand scratching the short stubble beard of his. “I’m sorry, but what is Darfaries?—”
141d320ad979.t: Harry bergumam, tangannya menggaruk janggut pendeknya yang kasar. “Maaf, tapi Darfaries itu apa?—”

1446bfee3acf.en: “I—dunno?” The stranger spoke, revealing his hands, shrugging until he remembered the stone he found in the ground earlier. I guess that has a nice sound to it. “Nari?”
1446bfee3acf.t: “Aku—entahlah?” kata orang asing itu, memperlihatkan tangannya, mengangkat bahu sampai ia teringat batu yang ia temukan di lantai tadi. Kurasa itu kedengarannya enak. “Nari?”

15933339b31d.en: “Hehe—that’s a new one—hey—remember to save it for Maiara as that’s why you’re here.” With a wink and a thin-lipped devious smile, Itagiba slapped Harry’s arm twice, then went his way down the stairs, only to turn his head back towards him. “By the way, you missed an opportunity to grab her hands, and give them a kiss.” Itagiba gave a smooth fingerbang, with a click of the tongue, then started walking down again. With his back to Harry, he said out loud, “But you can still ask her to wash your back! I will allow that!” He gave a thumbs up, disappearing into the stairs below.
15933339b31d.t: “Hehe—itu yang baru—hei—ingat simpan itu untuk Maiara, karena itulah alasan kau di sini.” Dengan kedipan mata dan senyum licik berbibir tipis, Itagiba menepuk lengan Harry dua kali, lalu turun tangga, hanya untuk menoleh kembali ke arahnya. “Ngomong-ngomong, kau melewatkan kesempatan untuk menggenggam tangannya, dan menciumnya.” Itagiba memberi isyarat jari keren, dengan decakan lidah, lalu mulai turun lagi. Membelakangi Harry, ia berkata keras-keras, “Tapi kau masih bisa memintanya menggosok punggungmu! Kuizinkan!” Ia mengacungkan jempol, menghilang ke tangga di bawah.

15d746c69715.en: This other floor was different from the others. The room itself was an open concept room split into two sides, with a corridor in the middle blocked by an old-looking wheelbarrow that led to a large door on the opposite side. On the left, flesh, bone, and feathers pickled in bottles of who-knows-what were all stacked up to the ceiling against the wall. In front of them, small and large cauldrons, workbenches, and knives stood closer to the corridor—truly a witch’s wet dream. What the fuck is all this? The stranger felt as if he just entered a haunted house, where everything felt unnatural or surreal.
15d746c69715.t: Lantai yang ini berbeda dari yang lain. Ruangannya sendiri berkonsep terbuka yang terbagi dua sisi, dengan lorong di tengah yang terhalang gerobak dorong tua yang mengarah ke pintu besar di seberang. Di sebelah kiri, daging, tulang, dan bulu yang diawetkan dalam botol-botol berisi entah apa, semuanya ditumpuk sampai ke langit-langit menempel di dinding. Di depannya, kuali-kuali kecil dan besar, meja kerja, dan pisau-pisau berdiri lebih dekat ke lorong—benar-benar mimpi basah seorang penyihir. Apa-apaan semua ini? Orang asing itu merasa seolah baru masuk ke rumah hantu, di mana segalanya terasa tidak wajar atau tidak nyata.

1686703b94cf.en: He felt his gut churn as one last memory rose, appearing as if it was unlocked, his soul unable to kept it protected any longer—he was a young skinny boy, back in his lovely childhood home, with a large grin on his face as he sat in between his parents, eating tacos, while a black-and-white chubby dog begged for food at their feet.
1686703b94cf.t: Ia merasakan perutnya bergejolak saat satu ingatan terakhir muncul, tampak seolah terbuka kuncinya, jiwanya tidak mampu lagi melindunginya—ia adalah seorang anak laki-laki kurus, kembali di rumah masa kecilnya yang indah, dengan senyum lebar di wajahnya saat duduk di antara kedua orang tuanya, makan taco, sementara seekor anjing gemuk hitam putih mengemis makanan di kaki mereka.

168ed133b7ff.en: Wait. Eleven is smaller than thirteen. The stranger computed the numbers on his head, trying to make sense of it all, at least until he saw Itagiba look at him and wink. Ohhhhh. I think I get it. The stranger kept muddling over the wink, and possible interpretations.
168ed133b7ff.t: Tunggu. Sebelas lebih kecil dari tiga belas. Orang asing itu menghitung angka-angka itu di kepalanya, mencoba memahami semuanya, setidaknya sampai ia melihat Itagiba memandangnya dan mengedipkan mata. Ohhhhh. Kayaknya aku paham. Orang asing itu terus memikirkan kedipan mata itu, dan kemungkinan tafsirannya.

1706d20b8f19.en: The stranger gulped. “I—I remember me and my parents were eating tacos when I was a kid—” The stranger felt the darkness come alive, grappling his heart, suffocating his lungs, but it was nothing but a vivid memory. “We’re watching—”
1706d20b8f19.t: Orang asing itu menelan ludah. “A—aku ingat aku dan orang tuaku makan taco waktu aku kecil—” Orang asing itu merasakan kegelapan hidup kembali, mencengkeram jantungnya, mencekik paru-parunya, tetapi itu hanyalah ingatan yang begitu nyata. “Kami sedang menonton—”

17eec29c1831.en: Sora looked up, towards the ceiling, “Eight. Sixteen, with quarter time hunk would be thirty-two in a day. I’m truly sorry, sir, but I do not know what twenty-four hours correlate to.” Sora’s toothy lips saddened, holding the fost lamp at her side, taking a longer bow.
17eec29c1831.t: Sora mendongak, ke arah langit-langit, “Delapan. Enam belas, dengan seperempat timehunk jadi tiga puluh dua dalam sehari. Saya sungguh minta maaf, Tuan, tapi saya tidak tahu dua puluh empat jam itu setara dengan apa.” Bibir Sora yang bergigi taring itu tampak sedih, sambil memegang lampu fost di sisinya, membungkuk lebih lama.

18313572d40e.en: “Ohhhh!” Harry murmured to himself, analyzing what initially appeared to be a circular makeup palette. There were eight color zones in the circle, with a blue emblem of an engraved fish sticking out in the middle. The four colors on the left were warmer in nature, while the right ones were cooler. Within each of those eight colors, there was a white word splitting the color in two. Harry read them clockwise as Monna, Monni, Monno, Munnu, Sunna, Sunni, Sunno, Sunnu. “This feels—pretty different. Wait—why is this chunk kinda lightened up?” Harry noticed half of one of the colors, at around ten o'clock, having a certain bioluminescence to it. It contrasted the other half, divided by a word that spelled out Sunno, with a darker orange color, akin to the inside of a pink grapefruit.
18313572d40e.t: “Ohhhh!” gumam Harry kepada dirinya sendiri, menganalisis benda yang awalnya tampak seperti palet riasan berbentuk lingkaran. Ada delapan zona warna di lingkaran itu, dengan lambang biru berupa ikan berukir yang menonjol di tengahnya. Empat warna di sebelah kiri bernuansa lebih hangat, sementara yang di kanan lebih sejuk. Di setiap delapan warna itu, ada satu kata putih yang membelah warnanya menjadi dua. Harry membacanya searah jarum jam sebagai Monna, Monni, Monno, Munnu, Sunna, Sunni, Sunno, Sunnu. “Ini terasa—cukup berbeda. Tunggu—kenapa bagian ini agak menyala?” Harry memperhatikan setengah dari salah satu warna, di sekitar posisi jam sepuluh, memiliki semacam bioluminesensi. Bagian itu kontras dengan setengah lainnya, yang dipisahkan oleh kata yang bertuliskan Sunno, dengan warna jingga yang lebih gelap, mirip bagian dalam jeruk bali merah muda.

185b4e7d7173.en: Making his way up to the fourth floor, he was panting as if he was about to have a heart attack. Exchanging quick eye contact with a portable-size cutesy maid called Sora, Harry smiled, wiping the sweat off his forehead.
185b4e7d7173.t: Sampai di lantai empat, ia terengah-engah seolah akan terkena serangan jantung. Bertukar pandang sekilas dengan pelayan imut seukuran saku bernama Sora, Harry tersenyum, menyeka keringat dari dahinya.

1912782ccd41.en: Despite the bustling city noises coming from outside the walls, an eerie silence ensued; everyone stood by, eager to know more, even Nina, the child in pink, and the black soulless eyes of the “Extra THICC” goth chicken she was mounted on—at least it appeared interested for a little bit, as it then quickly bobbled its head towards the ground to peck at something. The stranger admired the sheer size of the maybe-more-emo-than-goth chicken, almost as tall as the child in pink. “Ahhhh—I woke up in that tower?” The stranger pointed to the tower he just came out of.
1912782ccd41.t: Meski ada kebisingan kota yang ramai dari luar tembok, keheningan yang ganjil menyusul; semua orang berdiri menunggu, ingin tahu lebih banyak, bahkan Nina, anak berbaju merah muda, dan mata hitam tanpa jiwa ayam goth “Extra THICC” yang ia tunggangi—setidaknya ayam itu tampak tertarik sebentar, karena kemudian ia cepat-cepat mematukkan kepalanya ke tanah untuk mematuk sesuatu. Orang asing itu mengagumi besarnya ayam yang mungkin lebih emo daripada goth itu, hampir setinggi anak berbaju merah muda itu. “Ahhhh—aku terbangun di menara itu?” Orang asing itu menunjuk menara yang baru saja ia tinggalkan.

199adea1f9af.en: At the top of the spiraling stairs, his vision could not distinguish where one step started and the other ended, and it felt like a long way down if he dared to misstep. He held onto the blue, with accents of drying blood rails, as if his life depended on it. One step after the other, he made his way halfway down the flight of stairs, to another open window inviting him to see outside. He saw the same blurry bustling city from another angle, yet he could not recognize anything remotely familiar.
199adea1f9af.t: Di puncak tangga spiral, penglihatannya tidak bisa membedakan di mana satu anak tangga berawal dan yang lain berakhir, dan rasanya jauh sekali ke bawah kalau ia berani salah langkah. Ia berpegangan pada pegangan tangga biru, yang beraksen darah yang mulai mengering, seolah hidupnya bergantung padanya. Satu langkah demi satu langkah, ia turun sampai setengah tangga, ke jendela terbuka lain yang mengundangnya untuk melihat ke luar. Ia melihat kota ramai yang buram itu dari sudut lain, namun ia tidak bisa mengenali apa pun yang sedikit saja familier.

19b0a8f2f083.en: “THIRTEEN!” Itagiba shouted back, so enthusiastically that the stranger felt he was in the middle of a stock exchange.
19b0a8f2f083.t: “TIGA BELAS!” Itagiba balas berteriak, begitu antusias sampai orang asing itu merasa seperti berada di tengah bursa saham.

1a47850f3ee1.en: “You’re just like us, bud. I guess you’ve never seen a Wozefaries before, huh? Lemme tell ya, Sora is one of the cutest out there—right Sora?” Itagiba gave a wink to her.
1a47850f3ee1.t: “Kau sama seperti kami, Bro. Kurasa kau belum pernah lihat Wozefaries sebelumnya, ya? Biar kubilang, Sora itu salah satu yang paling imut di luar sana—iya kan, Sora?” Itagiba mengedipkan mata kepadanya.

1c2c84f342c9.en: Harry watched the blur of this foreign city, and the people going about their business, while his mind slowly drew distant with conflicting thoughts, and no single solid answer.
1c2c84f342c9.t: Harry memandangi kota asing yang buram ini, dan orang-orang yang sibuk dengan urusan mereka, sementara pikirannya perlahan menjauh dengan berbagai pikiran yang saling bertentangan, dan tanpa satu pun jawaban yang pasti.

1d20dee562d5.en: Eori was the first to pull her hand off the shake. Twitching her nose in disgust, she stepped back and put a fair amount of distance between them. Next, she seemed to isolate her hand from touching anywhere else in her body—acting like she had just touched a leper.
1d20dee562d5.t: Eori yang pertama menarik tangannya dari jabat tangan itu. Mengernyitkan hidungnya dengan jijik, ia melangkah mundur dan memberi jarak yang cukup jauh di antara mereka. Lalu, ia tampaknya mengisolasi tangannya agar tidak menyentuh bagian tubuhnya yang lain—bersikap seolah ia baru saja menyentuh penderita kusta.

1df312cf60d0.en: Harry, glancing at a blur that was Sora’s small hands, caught a red thing on the back of both of them. He worryingly pointed at it, his voice followed next “Ahhh—is that blood? Are you okay?”
1df312cf60d0.t: Harry, melirik sosok buram yang adalah tangan mungil Sora, menangkap sesuatu yang merah di punggung kedua tangannya. Ia menunjuknya dengan cemas, suaranya menyusul, “Ahhh—apa itu darah? Kamu baik-baik saja?”

1eb69c0eec21.en: With widened eyes at the TV, his laugh turned into gasp. Without looking away, his grubby hands felt around three tacos to his right, knowing exactly what the flavors were: carne asada, campechanos, and chorizo. Feeling adventurous, he selected the campechanos this time as every time he chewed on it, he felt a burst of a unique combination of leftover meat, plus special seasonings like cumin and cilantro, that his favorite taco shop would create—like opening a loot box, but rather than useless crap; it was a unique flavor experience.
1eb69c0eec21.t: Dengan mata terbelalak menatap TV, tawanya berubah menjadi tarikan napas tertahan. Tanpa mengalihkan pandangan, tangannya yang dekil meraba tiga taco di sebelah kanannya, tahu persis rasanya masing-masing: carne asada, campechanos, dan chorizo. Merasa ingin bertualang, kali ini ia memilih campechanos karena setiap kali ia mengunyahnya, ia merasakan ledakan kombinasi unik dari sisa-sisa daging, ditambah bumbu-bumbu istimewa seperti jintan dan ketumbar, yang diracik kedai taco favoritnya—seperti membuka loot box, tetapi alih-alih sampah tak berguna, yang ia dapat adalah pengalaman rasa yang unik.

204ec134908e.en: Feeling a sense of nothingness taking over, he clung tightly to his chair, no longer even knowing what color it was, nor its shape. He breathed out, but could no longer breathe in, and the more he tried, the more pain he felt from his collapsing lungs. The pain mutated into sheer agony, bringing the certainty of death to his door, causing his life to flash by in his head. However, the memories did not look vivid, but rather closer to old photos left to rot, barely being able to recognize what the memories were to begin with. He saw places that faintly felt familiar, but as he tried to remember them, he saw many more rotted memories pass by—like an unstoppable train disappearing in the horizon, never to be seen again. With each passing moment of pure darkness and agony, everything he knew, as corrupted as it was, became nothingness.
204ec134908e.t: Merasakan kehampaan mengambil alih, ia berpegangan erat pada kursinya, bahkan tidak lagi tahu apa warnanya, ataupun bentuknya. Ia mengembuskan napas, tetapi tidak bisa lagi menarik napas, dan semakin keras ia mencoba, semakin sakit yang ia rasakan dari paru-parunya yang mengempis. Rasa sakit itu bermutasi menjadi penderitaan luar biasa, membawa kepastian kematian ke depan pintunya, membuat hidupnya berkelebat di kepalanya. Namun, ingatan-ingatan itu tidak tampak jelas, melainkan lebih mirip foto-foto lama yang dibiarkan membusuk, nyaris tidak bisa dikenali ingatan apa sebenarnya. Ia melihat tempat-tempat yang samar-samar terasa familier, tetapi saat ia mencoba mengingatnya, ia melihat lebih banyak lagi ingatan busuk yang berlalu—seperti kereta tak terhentikan yang menghilang di cakrawala, tak akan pernah terlihat lagi. Dengan setiap detik kegelapan murni dan penderitaan yang berlalu, segala yang ia ketahui, serusak apa pun itu, menjadi kehampaan.

2227f7478bd5.en: Her voice reached Harry’s ears like a rap lullaby, but he then heard another familiar voice echo inside his head. You need to ask her to wash your back! “Can you?—” He tried to say it, but the words choked on his throat when her floppy ears and bright cyan eyes focused her attention on him. “Wash—eh?—I’m sorry. Oh! Humans! Is that the same thing as Naked Bruntos you mentioned early?” Harry let out an anguished breath.
2227f7478bd5.t: Suaranya sampai ke telinga Harry seperti lagu nina bobo versi rap, tetapi lalu ia mendengar suara lain yang familier bergema di dalam kepalanya. Kau harus memintanya menggosok punggungmu! “Bisa kamu?—” Ia mencoba mengatakannya, tetapi kata-kata itu tersangkut di tenggorokannya ketika telinga terkulai dan mata sian cerah gadis itu memusatkan perhatian padanya. “Gosok—eh?—maaf. Oh! Manusia! Apa itu sama dengan Naked Bruntos yang kamu sebut tadi?” Harry mengembuskan napas tersiksa.

228ea442c32e.en: The stranger felt his heartbeat go up by ten percent for every step Princess Eori came closer to him—his own drama and problems felt being shoved aside by sheer passion. With her standing an arm’s length in front of him, his eyes were now able to tell just how beautiful she actually was. Her face was slightly flushed, but her lips were tightly shut—it looked like she was biting her tongue to hold back something. She extended her hands, and shook his weak-ass grip with the same intensity as her father, but she kept her distance. Oh wow! The stranger felt his heart trying to get out of his own mouth as his cold, sweaty hand was caressed by her warmth. In turn, his grip became not-so-weak-ass while a funny bubbly feeling erupted inside him, further pushing the personal drama into the sidelines.
228ea442c32e.t: Orang asing itu merasakan detak jantungnya naik sepuluh persen setiap kali Putri Eori melangkah lebih dekat kepadanya—drama dan masalahnya sendiri terasa tersingkir oleh gairah semata. Dengan gadis itu berdiri sejarak satu lengan di depannya, matanya kini bisa melihat betapa cantiknya ia sebenarnya. Wajahnya agak merona, tetapi bibirnya terkatup rapat—ia tampak seperti menggigit lidahnya untuk menahan sesuatu. Ia mengulurkan tangannya, dan menjabat genggaman lemah orang asing itu dengan intensitas yang sama seperti ayahnya, tetapi ia tetap menjaga jarak. Oh wow! Orang asing itu merasakan jantungnya berusaha keluar dari mulutnya sendiri saat tangannya yang dingin dan berkeringat dibelai oleh kehangatan gadis itu. Sebaliknya, genggamannya menjadi tidak terlalu lemah sementara perasaan aneh yang meletup-letup muncul di dalam dirinya, semakin menyingkirkan drama pribadinya.

23f89cd7fd28.en: “That, sir? That’s a fost stone lamp.” Playing with her hands, Sora tried to hide away the embarrassment swelling within her. “Excuse my question, but do you know what a couch is?”
23f89cd7fd28.t: “Itu, Tuan? Itu lampu fost stone.” Sambil memainkan tangannya, Sora berusaha menyembunyikan rasa malu yang membengkak di dalam dirinya. “Maafkan pertanyaan saya, tapi apakah Anda tahu sofa itu apa?”

251a4719a335.en: With that pressure out of his system, he brought himself back to his original position, and grabbed a chorizo taco, and pigged out on it, followed by another bottle of beer. Meanwhile, the TV’s white light, and it’s kinda-like-heavy-rain noise remained perfectly steady, but its brightness was slowly, but progressively diminishing, letting the darkness encroach closer.
251a4719a335.t: Dengan tekanan itu keluar dari sistemnya, ia kembali ke posisi semula, mengambil taco chorizo, dan melahapnya dengan rakus, disusul sebotol bir lagi. Sementara itu, cahaya putih TV, dan bunyinya yang seperti hujan deras, tetap stabil sempurna, tetapi terangnya perlahan, namun pasti, berkurang, membiarkan kegelapan merayap semakin dekat.

2bc56e384b83.en: “Whatever, then—anything else?” Itagiba looked probing towards the stranger, appearing to not take “no” as an answer.
2bc56e384b83.t: “Ya sudahlah—ada lagi?” Itagiba menatap menyelidik ke arah orang asing itu, tampaknya tidak mau menerima “tidak” sebagai jawaban.

2e0845a5b412.en: “Your eyes are that bad, right? Well, grab her hand, and notice the bump. It is more like a nerve than a vein. See?” Itagiba smiled at Sora. “Give him a break, he just woke up from a near soul death.”
2e0845a5b412.t: “Matamu separah itu, kan? Yah, pegang tangannya, dan rasakan tonjolannya. Itu lebih mirip saraf daripada urat. Lihat?” Itagiba tersenyum kepada Sora. “Maklumi saja dia, dia baru bangun dari nyaris mengalami kematian jiwa.”

2ecf20b26a66.en: She said “R” twice in a row, making the same weird symbol. The fifth was a horizontal line that looked like a heart monitor that spiked down, then up-down, then down again. “Y!” She then ended her presentation by putting both hands up, and screaming as loud as she could, “HARRY! YAY!”
2ecf20b26a66.t: Ia berseru “R” dua kali berturut-turut, membuat simbol aneh yang sama. Yang kelima berupa garis horizontal yang tampak seperti monitor jantung yang melonjak turun, lalu naik-turun, lalu turun lagi. “Y!” Lalu ia mengakhiri pertunjukannya dengan mengangkat kedua tangan, dan berteriak sekeras-kerasnya, “HARRY! HORE!”

2ee7b2722402.en: Is that why there was all the blood and such? The stranger thought back to the room he woke up in. He placed his hand on his chest, feeling his pretty-much-alive heartbeat. “—but how am I alive?” The words slipped from his mouth, picturing his own dead body, far fatter than what he actually was, rotting in the slums. “I thought once you die, you actually die.”
2ee7b2722402.t: Jadi itu sebabnya ada semua darah dan lain-lain itu? Orang asing itu teringat kembali ruangan tempat ia terbangun. Ia meletakkan tangannya di dadanya, merasakan detak jantungnya yang jelas-jelas masih hidup. “—tapi bagaimana aku bisa hidup?” Kata-kata itu lolos dari mulutnya, membayangkan mayatnya sendiri, jauh lebih gemuk dari dirinya yang sebenarnya, membusuk di permukiman kumuh. “Kukira begitu kita mati, ya kita benar-benar mati.”

30cc3ce5bf5f.en: With the door to the bathroom closed, a stranger appeared on the back of the door. Harry raised his hand to say hi, but the stranger did it at the same time. Coming closer to compensate for his blurry eyes, Harry confirmed it was just a polished steel mirror pinned reflecting his own body. Touching his gut, he saw himself doing the same in the mirror. When did I lose weight, and become this hairy?—Maybe my time in the slums? But how did I end up there? Didn’t I work like—wait? Where did I work?
30cc3ce5bf5f.t: Dengan pintu kamar mandi tertutup, sesosok orang asing muncul di balik pintu. Harry mengangkat tangannya untuk menyapa, tetapi orang asing itu melakukannya pada saat yang sama. Mendekat untuk mengimbangi matanya yang buram, Harry memastikan itu hanyalah cermin baja mengilap yang dipasang, memantulkan tubuhnya sendiri. Menyentuh perutnya, ia melihat dirinya melakukan hal yang sama di cermin. Kapan berat badanku turun, dan jadi berbulu begini?—Mungkin waktu aku di permukiman kumuh? Tapi bagaimana aku bisa sampai di sana? Bukannya aku kerja di—tunggu? Aku kerja di mana?

32744be95a13.en: “Huh?” He slowly revealed his face, easing them into the noises and sights from the world; the sounds of a brisling city now sounded like a symphony of normalcy: People talking and laughing, animals trotting, birds chirping, and even sounds of something hard steadily hitting wood not too far away.
32744be95a13.t: “Hah?” Ia perlahan memperlihatkan wajahnya, membiasakannya dengan suara dan pemandangan dunia; suara kota yang ramai kini terdengar seperti simfoni kenormalan: orang-orang berbicara dan tertawa, hewan-hewan berderap, burung-burung berkicau, dan bahkan bunyi sesuatu yang keras memukul kayu dengan teratur tak jauh dari situ.

3365a396fef0.en: “Aww shit. I forgot about that.” The towering man scratched his short hair, turning to the stranger “So—got anything in mind?”
3365a396fef0.t: “Aduh, sial. Aku lupa soal itu.” Pria jangkung itu menggaruk rambut pendeknya, berbalik ke orang asing itu, “Jadi—ada ide?”

33cce9408b5f.en: “Wow!” Harry, mouth-opened, saw pure magic happen in front of his eyes. “That’s amazing!”
33cce9408b5f.t: “Wow!” Harry, dengan mulut menganga, melihat sihir murni terjadi di depan matanya. “Luar biasa!”

33ff62312909.en: Closing her eyes, Neferteri softly shook her head.

34f656de70a1.en: “You’re welcome, Sir Harry. Please take your time. Dinner will be served at Monnalow.” Sora, with a curtsy posy, pulled on the sides of her black skirt, getting ready to leave.
34f656de70a1.t: “Sama-sama, Tuan Harry. Silakan bersantai. Makan malam akan disajikan pada Monnalow.” Sora, dengan pose hormat, menarik sisi-sisi rok hitamnya, bersiap untuk pergi.

35873ced47ed.en: With squinting eyes, the stranger looked from person to person, trying to recognize them, but it was to no avail; they looked like strangers to him, too. That is until his eyes crossed paths with a beautiful girl in long violet hair that sparkled in the sun. He had never seen her before, but he now wanted to see her more. With an interested smile, the stranger wanted to take a step closer to really see her beautiful pinkish, or maybe purplish eyes, but his feet were planted firmly on the ground; too shy to move. At least he could see a bit of how her skin looked spotless and radiant, and even her demeanor, too! She looked away from him, holding back her tensed up posture, clutching her elbows tightly against herself, forcing a neutral face, only to start playing with her hair as the stranger kept staring on.
35873ced47ed.t: Dengan mata menyipit, orang asing itu memandang dari satu orang ke orang lain, mencoba mengenali mereka, tetapi sia-sia; mereka juga tampak asing baginya. Sampai matanya bertemu dengan seorang gadis cantik berambut ungu panjang yang berkilauan di bawah matahari. Ia belum pernah melihatnya sebelumnya, tetapi sekarang ia ingin melihatnya lebih lama. Dengan senyum penuh minat, orang asing itu ingin melangkah lebih dekat untuk benar-benar melihat matanya yang indah, yang kemerahmudaan, atau mungkin keunguan, tetapi kakinya tertanam kuat di tanah; terlalu malu untuk bergerak. Setidaknya ia bisa sedikit melihat betapa kulitnya mulus dan bercahaya, dan sikapnya juga! Gadis itu membuang muka darinya, menahan postur tubuhnya yang tegang, mendekap sikunya erat-erat ke tubuhnya, memaksakan wajah datar, lalu mulai memainkan rambutnya sementara orang asing itu terus menatap.

37bd531f821d.en: Meanwhile, Neferteri was gritting her teeth, at least for a bit before holding back her emotions when the stranger noticed an aura of unspoken anger coming from her—like the warmth irradiating from a fire. Meanwhile, Eori was keeping her distance, and mostly to herself by appearing to now enjoy the large clouds forming in the distance—apparently just biding time.
37bd531f821d.t: Sementara itu, Neferteri menggertakkan giginya, setidaknya sebentar sebelum menahan emosinya ketika orang asing itu merasakan aura amarah yang tak terucap darinya—seperti hangat yang memancar dari api. Sementara itu, Eori tetap menjaga jarak, dan lebih banyak menyendiri dengan tampaknya kini menikmati awan-awan besar yang terbentuk di kejauhan—tampaknya sekadar menunggu waktu.

3837b28637dc.en: Sora, quickly fumbling her fingers as if she was making gang signs, grew red as a tomato. “I don’t think I am, but—but thank you for your words, King.”
3837b28637dc.t: Sora, cepat-cepat memainkan jari-jarinya seolah membuat isyarat geng, menjadi merah seperti tomat. “Saya rasa tidak, tapi—tapi terima kasih atas kata-kata Anda, Baginda.”

39bad48eb157.en: The pupils of his eyes adjusted themselves to the light in the room, allowing him to see a textured white, but blurry white ceiling. Slowly sitting up, his stiff body cracked all over, sounding like someone just popped a roll of bubble wrap. With a huge yawn, he involuntarily stretched himself, causing additional cracks, with one on his neck sounding like someone just snapped it. A constrained, nearly orgasmic, grunt came out of the stranger, feeling his tensed up muscles relaxing, like oiling up an old machinery.
39bad48eb157.t: Pupil matanya menyesuaikan diri dengan cahaya di ruangan, memungkinkannya melihat langit-langit putih bertekstur, tetapi buram. Perlahan duduk, tubuhnya yang kaku berderak di mana-mana, terdengar seperti seseorang baru saja memecahkan segulung plastik gelembung. Dengan menguap lebar, ia meregangkan tubuhnya tanpa sadar, menimbulkan derakan tambahan, dengan satu di lehernya terdengar seperti seseorang baru saja mematahkannya. Erangan tertahan, nyaris penuh kenikmatan, keluar dari orang asing itu, merasakan otot-ototnya yang tegang mengendur, seperti meminyaki mesin tua.

3f41597ee93d.en: With the intensity of the toothpaste dying down, a perfect amount of refreshing citrusy mixed with herbal tea remained in his mouth. All right. Tastes nice if it is just a bit—I guess. Gonna have to watch out for everything I think I know. Harry let out a deep breath, shoving the slightly wet toothbrush into the drawer, closing it, and making his way to the bathtub. He approached it with a growing suspicion, and slowly stuck his finger inside, waiting for perhaps what could be nearly boiling hot water to melt his finger away. Instead, the water had the right degree of warmth. Hmmmm. At least that feels normal. He took off his boxers in a fell swoop, slowly submersed one foot in, then stepped around to ensure it was an actual bathtub before immersing the rest of his corpulent body in, and letting it soak up the warmth.
3f41597ee93d.t: Saat intensitas pasta gigi itu mereda, perpaduan sempurna antara rasa jeruk yang menyegarkan dengan teh herbal tertinggal di mulutnya. Baiklah. Rasanya enak kalau cuma sedikit—kurasa. Aku harus hati-hati dengan semua yang kukira kutahu. Harry mengembuskan napas dalam-dalam, menjejalkan sikat gigi yang agak basah itu ke laci, menutupnya, dan berjalan ke bak mandi. Ia mendekatinya dengan kecurigaan yang semakin besar, dan perlahan mencelupkan jarinya, menunggu kalau-kalau air yang hampir mendidih akan melelehkan jarinya. Sebaliknya, airnya memiliki tingkat kehangatan yang pas. Hmmmm. Setidaknya yang ini terasa normal. Ia melepas boxernya dalam satu gerakan, perlahan memasukkan satu kaki, lalu melangkah ke sana kemari untuk memastikan itu memang bak mandi sungguhan sebelum merendam sisa tubuhnya yang gemuk, dan membiarkannya menyerap kehangatan.

4154051c8b34.en: “You okay there, bud?” Itagiba’s eyes grew concerned. He put his hand on Harry’s sweaty, stinky back, and pushed him forward. “C’mon! You can do it!”
4154051c8b34.t: “Kau baik-baik saja, Bro?” Mata Itagiba berubah khawatir. Ia meletakkan tangannya di punggung Harry yang berkeringat dan bau, lalu mendorongnya maju. “Ayo! Kau pasti bisa!”

42aab3a3ce78.en: Chapter II subchapter 4: split panel of a cheerful red-haired maid waving on a staircase and Harry nervous beside a dark-haired man.
42aab3a3ce78.t: Bab II subbab 4: panel terbelah berisi seorang pelayan berambut merah yang ceria melambai di tangga dan Harry yang gugup di samping pria berambut gelap.

49db26687570.en: “What else?” The towering man’s tone grew even blunter as his eyes were keen on the stranger’s expression.
49db26687570.t: “Apa lagi?” Nada pria jangkung itu semakin blak-blakan sementara matanya tajam memperhatikan ekspresi orang asing itu.

4aad84564a7c.en: “Fanbiro! C’mon!” Before Neferteri could even finish, Nina had already pulled the feathers of her goth bird, performing an exit maneuver with her mount.
4aad84564a7c.t: “Fanbiro! Ayo!” Bahkan sebelum Neferteri selesai, Nina sudah menarik bulu burung goth-nya, melakukan manuver kabur bersama tunggangannya.

4babe20c3ea7.en: Neferteri continued, “—and this lovely purple-haired-lady is the third princess Eori—”
4babe20c3ea7.t: Neferteri melanjutkan, “—dan wanita cantik berambut ungu ini adalah putri ketiga, Eori—”

4cd44ffb4c05.en: The stranger chuckled as he saw Nina, with her hair flying up in the air, wildly giggling, and her trusted mount, leaving black feathers behind as they both ran towards the back of the castle, vanishing from sight.
4cd44ffb4c05.t: Orang asing itu terkekeh melihat Nina, dengan rambutnya berkibar di udara, cekikikan liar, dan tunggangan tepercayanya, meninggalkan bulu-bulu hitam saat keduanya berlari menuju bagian belakang kastil, menghilang dari pandangan.

50fe6063685f.en: Moving his attention to the rails of the upward spiraling stairs, Harry saw a small glimpse of a blurry image, of which his brain had just enough imagination to fill in the gap: yellow underwear with white embroidery belonging to the cutesy small legs of the fiery-red-haired maid.
50fe6063685f.t: Mengalihkan perhatiannya ke pegangan tangga spiral yang naik, Harry melihat sekilas gambar yang buram, yang cukup untuk diisi oleh imajinasi otaknya: celana dalam kuning dengan bordiran putih milik kaki-kaki mungil yang imut dari pelayan berambut merah menyala itu.

54b46287720e.en: The child in pink pointed her tiny finger at the stranger. “MOM! He looks like Uncle Alford!” Her eyes shone in delight seeing someone familiar. “Even his belly, too!”
54b46287720e.t: Anak berbaju merah muda itu menunjuk orang asing itu dengan jari mungilnya. “MAMA! Dia mirip Paman Alford!” Matanya berbinar gembira melihat seseorang yang familier. “Perutnya juga!”

55de836ce525.en: Chapter II subchapter 5: a red-haired maid holds out a round colored dial toward a seated man in a room with a bathtub.
55de836ce525.t: Bab II subbab 5: seorang pelayan berambut merah mengulurkan piringan bundar berwarna ke arah pria yang duduk di ruangan dengan bak mandi.

57817b8b5dfd.en: His ears heard the usual sounds of a busy city, but somehow it felt amplified, as if they were screaming in his ears, obnoxiously loud. A soothing, slightly chill wind blew through the room, but he shivered as if someone just poured a bucket of icy water over him.
57817b8b5dfd.t: Telinganya mendengar suara-suara biasa dari kota yang sibuk, tetapi entah kenapa terasa diperkeras, seolah suara-suara itu berteriak di telinganya, keras sekali sampai menjengkelkan. Angin sejuk yang menenangkan dan sedikit dingin berembus melewati ruangan, tetapi ia menggigil seolah seseorang baru saja menyiramnya dengan seember air es.

581212151e4d.en: “Like—a part of a day? Twenty-four hours?” Harry showed the color swatch that somehow told the time to Sora, pointing at the lighted section. “Like wouldn't this be ten—ahhh.” Harry’s hands froze in the air like a mime. His mind clearly felt like there was something that came after ten, but it just wouldn’t come out. Ten hours? No—? Harry scratched his beard.
581212151e4d.t: “Seperti—bagian dari satu hari? Dua puluh empat jam?” Harry menunjukkan contoh warna yang entah bagaimana menunjukkan waktu itu kepada Sora, menunjuk bagian yang menyala. “Misalnya bukankah ini jam sepuluh—ahhh.” Tangan Harry membeku di udara seperti pantomim. Pikirannya jelas merasa ada sesuatu yang datang setelah sepuluh, tetapi tidak mau keluar juga. Sepuluh jam? Bukan—? Harry menggaruk janggutnya.

586702c83837.en: “All right, Harry. What do you want for dinner?” Itagiba cracked his neck as he kept walking, passing by the middle tower.
586702c83837.t: “Baiklah, Harry. Kau mau makan malam apa?” Itagiba meregangkan lehernya sampai berbunyi sambil terus berjalan, melewati menara tengah.

5a1a1711bbfb.en: In the corridor, the wheelbarrow exuded a familiar odd smell. Taking a sniff of the air around him, the stranger’s mind clicked as to what it was. That smells just like the room I was in! Was I brought in then? He peeked at the wooden tiles in the ground and noticed the same faint bloodied footprints passing both ways in the corridor. Looking up, he saw the same glass, but this time metal instead of wood jars with whitish stones inside. That has to be a lamp, right?
5a1a1711bbfb.t: Di lorong, gerobak dorong itu menguarkan bau aneh yang familier. Mengendus udara di sekitarnya, pikiran orang asing itu langsung paham bau apa itu. Baunya persis seperti ruangan tempatku tadi! Jadi aku dibawa masuk? Ia melirik ubin kayu di lantai dan melihat jejak kaki berdarah samar yang sama melintas ke dua arah di lorong. Mendongak, ia melihat kaca yang sama, tetapi kali ini stoplesnya dari logam, bukan kayu, dengan batu-batu keputihan di dalamnya. Itu pasti lampu, kan?

5a232622985a.en: Sora’s hand reached out to an apparent danger. “Please watch out for the glass or you might hurt your hand.”
5a232622985a.t: Tangan Sora terulur menghadapi bahaya yang tampak jelas. “Tolong hati-hati dengan kacanya atau tangan Anda bisa terluka.”

611c5b346ae6.en: “Yeah. That. Do you know what that is?” Itagiba glanced at her.
611c5b346ae6.t: “Iya. Itu. Kau tahu itu apa?” Itagiba meliriknya.

61309207dd41.en: Meanwhile Sora’s eyes grew watery from the Bagarisa musk burning up her sensitive nose. Sounding as if she was stuffed, she tried to not breathe from her nose as she spoke up “Sir—is there anything else you need?”
61309207dd41.t: Sementara itu, mata Sora berkaca-kaca karena musk Bagarisa yang membakar hidungnya yang sensitif. Terdengar seperti hidungnya tersumbat, ia berusaha tidak bernapas lewat hidung saat berbicara, “Tuan—apakah ada lagi yang Anda butuhkan?”

617dd286fde2.en: “So, what else other than eating tacos and watching—what was it again?” Itagiba, the towering king, looked firmly back at the stranger.
617dd286fde2.t: “Jadi, apa lagi selain makan taco dan menonton—apa tadi?” Itagiba, sang raja jangkung, kembali menatap tegas orang asing itu.

61bef16f8fc9.en: Eating the taco with the same voracity as the previous one, he then gulped down a large glass filled with Vienna lager like a camel. Putting the glass aside, he was ready to send in another taco when he paused his grubby hands, using it to bend his body to the right instead. His face contorted, and reddened—like a baby trying to poop. His butt cheeks, now spread out apart, gave way for a sudden gust of stench air to blow through, sounding like someone trying to whistle for the first time in their life.
61bef16f8fc9.t: Memakan taco itu dengan kerakusan yang sama seperti sebelumnya, ia lalu meneguk segelas besar Vienna lager seperti unta. Meletakkan gelasnya, ia sudah siap memasukkan taco lagi ketika ia menghentikan tangannya yang dekil, malah memakainya untuk memiringkan tubuhnya ke kanan. Wajahnya berkerut, dan memerah—seperti bayi yang sedang berusaha buang air besar. Belahan bokongnya, kini merenggang, memberi jalan bagi embusan udara bau yang tiba-tiba, terdengar seperti seseorang yang mencoba bersiul untuk pertama kalinya seumur hidup.

62095e81f0e7.en: “I—I saw them disappear, and then I was left—alone. That’s it. Well, I remember everything being dark too—I thought it was my living room, but maybe it was a dream? I think?” The stranger’s eyes wandered away; he went silent as the crippling darkness began crawling back to his mind the further he pushed it to remember what happened.
62095e81f0e7.t: “A—aku melihat mereka menghilang, lalu aku ditinggal—sendirian. Itu saja. Yah, aku ingat semuanya gelap juga—kukira itu ruang tamuku, tapi mungkin itu mimpi? Kurasa?” Mata orang asing itu menerawang; ia terdiam saat kegelapan yang melumpuhkan mulai merayap kembali ke pikirannya semakin keras ia memaksa diri mengingat apa yang terjadi.

625dec64291c.en: “I—guess I can try. I never made them before though—” Harry and Itagiba entered the main floor of the Southeast tower—the tower opposite the one he had woken up in. The main floor was wildly different; no longer a witch’s wet dream, but rather a large living room of sorts with couches, stuff for painting, books, and glass jars that looked like lamps, but with whitish, pearly stones inside them that sparkled in the sunlight of the open window—kinda similar to the other ones he had seen in the other tower. In the nearby ground, drawings, with an awful lot of pink, littered the floor as if a tornado had passed through.
625dec64291c.t: “Aku—kurasa bisa kucoba. Tapi aku belum pernah membuatnya sebelumnya—” Harry dan Itagiba memasuki lantai utama Southeast tower—menara yang berseberangan dengan menara tempat ia terbangun. Lantai utamanya sangat berbeda; bukan lagi mimpi basah seorang penyihir, melainkan semacam ruang keluarga yang besar dengan sofa-sofa, peralatan melukis, buku-buku, dan toples-toples kaca yang tampak seperti lampu, tetapi dengan batu-batu keputihan seperti mutiara di dalamnya yang berkilauan di bawah sinar matahari dari jendela yang terbuka—agak mirip dengan yang ia lihat di menara lain. Di lantai dekat situ, gambar-gambar, dengan banyak sekali warna merah muda, berserakan di lantai seolah tornado baru lewat.

63bcf9dd7f0f.en: Harry, passing by the south tower, walking towards the southeast one, instantly remembered one thing only. “Hah—tacos?”
63bcf9dd7f0f.t: Harry, melewati south tower, berjalan menuju menara tenggara, seketika hanya teringat satu hal. “Hah—taco?”

64644be325e7.en: Feeling a squeeze on his breath, and a sinking heart, the stranger took one last glance at the cute girl in purple—feeling like she had already dumped him before he even had the chance to say hi. Turning his attention to the unwavering will coming from this tall man, he felt like he had no choice but to shake his hand. As their hands met, the stranger imagined his hand being crushed by his tight grip, but instead the handshake itself felt rather welcoming; his own slightly cold hands, and weaker grip, were met with a firm, supportive handshake. “Ah—sorry—ahhh—but I don’t know.” Muttering words came out amidst hums from the stranger, looking up to the red, fiery, but somehow natural-looking eyes of this tall man.
64644be325e7.t: Merasa napasnya tercekat, dan hatinya tenggelam, orang asing itu melirik sekali terakhir ke gadis imut berbaju ungu itu—merasa seolah gadis itu sudah mencampakkannya sebelum ia sempat menyapa. Mengalihkan perhatiannya pada tekad tak tergoyahkan dari pria jangkung ini, ia merasa tak punya pilihan selain menjabat tangannya. Saat tangan mereka bertemu, orang asing itu membayangkan tangannya diremukkan oleh cengkeraman yang kuat, tetapi jabat tangan itu justru terasa cukup ramah; tangannya sendiri yang agak dingin, dan genggamannya yang lebih lemah, disambut jabat tangan yang mantap dan suportif. “Ah—maaf—ahhh—tapi aku tidak tahu.” Kata-kata bergumam keluar di tengah gumaman orang asing itu, mendongak menatap mata merah membara pria jangkung ini, yang entah bagaimana tampak alami.

650c890e8eed.en: Quickly bowing, Sora replied in her usual rap freestyle fashion—at least in terms of speed. “Yes, King! I will do it immediately!” The maid then took off upstairs in a rush as if her life depended on it.
650c890e8eed.t: Cepat-cepat membungkuk, Sora menjawab dengan gaya rap freestyle-nya yang biasa—setidaknya dalam hal kecepatan. “Baik, Baginda! Akan segera saya lakukan!” Pelayan itu lalu bergegas naik seolah hidupnya bergantung pada hal itu.

66cf3aab4584.en: Harry, realizing where his mind was at, let go of her nearly-violated hand. “Thank you—ah—Sora.” His hands and imagination still wanted to play with it some more, but then he remembered the words Marry a princess. Paying close attention to her humanoid figure as she stepped back, he then noticed her ears were pretty different from what a normal ear was; hers had a pointy shape, like an elf’s, but it flopped inward like certain dog breeds. Touching his own ear, Harry felt the normal roundness instead.
66cf3aab4584.t: Harry, menyadari ke mana pikirannya melayang, melepaskan tangan gadis itu yang nyaris dilecehkan. “Terima kasih—ah—Sora.” Tangan dan imajinasinya masih ingin memainkannya lagi, tetapi lalu ia teringat kata-kata Menikahi seorang putri. Memperhatikan baik-baik sosok humanoidnya saat ia melangkah mundur, ia lalu menyadari telinganya cukup berbeda dari telinga normal; telinganya berbentuk runcing, seperti telinga peri, tetapi terkulai ke dalam seperti ras anjing tertentu. Menyentuh telinganya sendiri, Harry malah merasakan kebulatan yang normal.

675b68d03ec2.en: A small chuckle came out of Itagiba. “Pfff—you sure? That’s kind of lame, you know? We can give you a better name.”
675b68d03ec2.t: Kekehan kecil keluar dari Itagiba. “Pfff—kau yakin? Agak payah, tahu? Kami bisa memberimu nama yang lebih bagus.”

68292393253f.en: “I’m sorry, sir, but what is an hour?” Sora’s ear perked up, trying to listen to Harry as clearly as she could.
68292393253f.t: “Maafkan saya, Tuan, tapi jam itu apa?” Telinga Sora menegak, berusaha mendengarkan Harry sejelas mungkin.

69ecb9b97d9a.en: “Nina Sanbi Royal!” Neferteri, the only one not laughing, called out to her in the same vibe that a Latino mother would right before taking out one of her sandals and performing a headshot with it. However, she did not reach out for hers, or whatever else she wore under her long blue dress. Rather, she remained calm, at least in how she composed herself.
69ecb9b97d9a.t: “Nina Sanbi Royal!” Neferteri, satu-satunya yang tidak tertawa, memanggilnya dengan aura yang sama seperti seorang ibu Latin tepat sebelum melepas salah satu sandalnya dan melakukan headshot dengannya. Namun, ia tidak meraih sandalnya, atau apa pun yang ia pakai di balik gaun biru panjangnya. Sebaliknya, ia tetap tenang, setidaknya dalam caranya membawa diri.

69fa0a254c16.en: “I’m sorry—but what is Monnalow?” Harry held his face as if was about to be told that’s enough.
69fa0a254c16.t: “Maaf—tapi Monnalow itu apa?” Harry memegangi wajahnya seolah akan diberi tahu sudah cukup.

6a265c8fd422.en: Nina bowed before making her way back into the castle, savoring the victory of her newly struck deal.
6a265c8fd422.t: Nina membungkuk sebelum kembali masuk ke kastil, menikmati kemenangan kesepakatan barunya.

6a2c1e9650a1.en: Harry went to take a step to follow her, but the king gripped his arm again, holding him in place.
6a2c1e9650a1.t: Harry hendak melangkah mengikutinya, tetapi sang raja mencengkeram lengannya lagi, menahannya di tempat.

6c9c427ec7fa.en: Spitting some of the syrup into the sink, he then pulled on the handle attached to the pipe to let the water flow. Sticking his mouth into the pseudo waterfall, a refreshing taste came through, only to then turn into as if he was swallowing cold water from a freezing lake. Coughing his lungs out, while trying to breathe through the pain, he agonized, trying to use the toothbrush to scrape off this powerful concoction of his tongue.
6c9c427ec7fa.t: Meludahkan sebagian sirup itu ke wastafel, ia lalu menarik tuas yang terpasang di pipa untuk mengalirkan air. Menyodorkan mulutnya ke air terjun semu itu, rasa yang menyegarkan muncul, hanya untuk kemudian berubah seolah ia sedang menelan air dingin dari danau yang membeku. Terbatuk-batuk hebat, sambil berusaha bernapas menahan sakit, ia tersiksa, mencoba memakai sikat gigi untuk mengerik ramuan yang dahsyat ini dari lidahnya.

6d693f8cfd73.en: On the right, bookshelves were filled with all kinds of books in different shapes and colors, with some looking so old that they would probably curse you or fall apart into dust the moment you opened it—truly the kind of gift to someone with rhinitis. But the books were not the only thing decorating the right side of the room; weirdly shaped two-finger rings, that looked like what a flashy rapper would wear, decorated a section of the wall. In front of that was a table with grinders dirty with blue dust and boxes in a familiar green wood color that contained blue stones and blue dust. At the base of the table, a large, raw, unpainted wood crate was filled with used diamond-like colored stones, looking pretty close to what the stranger had seen back in the room he woke up in.
6d693f8cfd73.t: Di sebelah kanan, rak-rak buku dipenuhi segala macam buku dengan berbagai bentuk dan warna, beberapa tampak begitu tua sehingga mungkin akan mengutukmu atau hancur menjadi debu begitu kamu membukanya—benar-benar hadiah yang pas untuk penderita rinitis. Tetapi buku-buku itu bukan satu-satunya hiasan di sisi kanan ruangan; cincin dua jari berbentuk aneh, yang tampak seperti yang dipakai rapper yang norak, menghiasi satu bagian dinding. Di depannya ada meja dengan alat-alat penggiling yang kotor oleh debu biru dan kotak-kotak berwarna kayu hijau yang familier berisi batu biru dan debu biru. Di kaki meja, sebuah peti besar dari kayu mentah tanpa cat dipenuhi batu-batu bekas berwarna mirip berlian, tampak cukup mirip dengan yang dilihat orang asing itu di ruangan tempat ia terbangun.

6dd9428a4446.en: Weird. The stranger took his time walking to the door, looking at how foreign everything looked.
6dd9428a4446.t: Aneh. Orang asing itu berjalan pelan menuju pintu, memperhatikan betapa asingnya segala sesuatu.

6e799b14cb87.en: Feeling like she dumped him a second time, the stranger could not think of anything to say, instead an ass-licking smile appeared on him as he looked at his own self, realizing he was in the wrong, making the bubbly feeling inside him fizzle out like a soda left open in the fridge.
6e799b14cb87.t: Merasa dicampakkan untuk kedua kalinya, orang asing itu tidak bisa memikirkan apa pun untuk dikatakan, malah senyum penjilat muncul di wajahnya saat ia memandangi dirinya sendiri, menyadari bahwa dialah yang salah, membuat perasaan meletup-letup di dalam dirinya mendesis habis seperti soda yang dibiarkan terbuka di kulkas.

6f5513a8bdbf.en: “—I don’t remember much, but—Oh! The—doggo! I can’t remember his name either, but he was black and white. We were watching TV while he begged for food—he disappeared. Then—so did my parents. I, somehow, felt old and fat after that—lonely too.” The stranger’s voice tapered at the end. He looked at the ground, feeling an urge rising within him to cry out the darkness gripping his heart, but seeing the cute girl in purple glance at him, he held the tears back with all of the emotional strength that he could muster.
6f5513a8bdbf.t: “—Aku tidak ingat banyak, tapi—Oh! Si—anjing! Aku juga tidak ingat namanya, tapi dia hitam putih. Kami sedang menonton TV sementara dia mengemis makanan—lalu dia menghilang. Lalu—orang tuaku juga. Aku, entah bagaimana, merasa tua dan gemuk setelah itu—kesepian juga.” Suara orang asing itu memelan di akhir. Ia menatap tanah, merasakan dorongan yang muncul dalam dirinya untuk menangisi kegelapan yang mencengkeram hatinya, tetapi melihat gadis imut berbaju ungu itu meliriknya, ia menahan air matanya dengan seluruh kekuatan emosional yang bisa ia kumpulkan.

704fe5c4c983.en: Neferteri, seeming to realize the misunderstanding, spoke after. “The princess in question is our second princess, Maiara. Upon hearing the news, she decided to assist our courtroom scientist, Gabiro, and fell heart-struck once she saw you being resurrected.”
704fe5c4c983.t: Neferteri, tampaknya menyadari kesalahpahaman itu, berbicara setelahnya. “Putri yang dimaksud adalah putri kedua kami, Maiara. Setelah mendengar kabar itu, ia memutuskan untuk membantu ilmuwan istana kami, Gabiro, dan langsung jatuh hati begitu melihat Anda dibangkitkan.”

70712fd6a5b0.en: An eagerly energetic voice came from the child in pink. “Nina! The four-h, and best princess! With her tru-ted mount, Fanbiro!”
70712fd6a5b0.t: Suara yang bersemangat dan enerjik datang dari anak berbaju merah muda itu. “Nina! Putri keempa, dan putri terbaik! Dengan tunggangan tepecayanya, Fanbiro!”

7225d712fa4b.en: Harry followed suit. As he got half-way into the room, he saw a two-person table with its top partly carved, looking like a three-dimensional painted wooden battlefield of sorts, containing clusters of statues on top, each forming battalions of humanoids, animals, or even monsters. By the stairs, he saw a bookcase that was filled with stuff other than books: additional figures, statues, balls of different shapes, and even additional boards that looked like pieces of battlefield. His mind suddenly clicked on a spoken foreign name. “Sorry, who’s Eiri?”
7225d712fa4b.t: Harry mengikutinya. Saat ia sampai di tengah ruangan, ia melihat meja untuk dua orang yang permukaannya sebagian diukir, tampak seperti semacam medan perang kayu tiga dimensi yang dicat, dengan kelompok-kelompok patung di atasnya, masing-masing membentuk batalion humanoid, hewan, atau bahkan monster. Di dekat tangga, ia melihat rak buku yang diisi barang-barang selain buku: figur-figur tambahan, patung, bola-bola berbagai bentuk, dan bahkan papan-papan tambahan yang tampak seperti potongan medan perang. Pikirannya tiba-tiba teringat sebuah nama asing yang diucapkan. “Maaf, Eiri itu siapa?”

74f6e7c4b3c4.en: “Yes, sir,” Sora hid her hands behind her back. “Do you need an explanation of the room?”
74f6e7c4b3c4.t: “Benar, Tuan,” Sora menyembunyikan tangannya di belakang punggung. “Apakah Anda perlu penjelasan tentang kamar ini?”

76250625c766.en: Turning his attention to the broken window, he carefully peaked his head through and saw a sprawling city as far as the eyes could see. At least it looked like one, as it was a blurry mess of boxy-shaped buildings of all kinds, with a somewhat repeating color palette of white with bluish or brownish roofs that seemed to be on fire. Actually, the entire city seemed on fire. Is that fire? Wait. No. That’s a chimney! A wind blew through, bringing the smell of pastry, smoked meat, and fish. The stranger looked at the people past a grayish wall of some kind, and saw blurry humanoid figures in the distance that did not seem to be in any rush, at least most of them. Well, except a pink and white eye-catching humanoid running by herself, zig-zagging through the populace appearing to hold something.
76250625c766.t: Mengalihkan perhatiannya ke jendela yang pecah, ia dengan hati-hati melongokkan kepalanya dan melihat kota yang membentang sejauh mata memandang. Setidaknya tampak seperti kota, karena yang terlihat hanyalah kekacauan buram bangunan-bangunan berbentuk kotak dari segala jenis, dengan palet warna yang agak berulang: putih dengan atap kebiruan atau kecokelatan yang tampak terbakar. Sebenarnya, seluruh kota tampak terbakar. Apa itu api? Tunggu. Bukan. Itu cerobong asap! Angin berembus, membawa aroma kue, daging asap, dan ikan. Orang asing itu memandang orang-orang di balik semacam tembok keabu-abuan, dan melihat sosok-sosok humanoid buram di kejauhan yang tampaknya tidak terburu-buru, setidaknya sebagian besar dari mereka. Yah, kecuali satu sosok humanoid merah muda dan putih yang mencolok, berlari sendirian, berzig-zag di antara penduduk, tampak memegang sesuatu.

7684de106b64.en: What appeared to be mere seconds later, a familiar pink humanoid, but no longer with her trusted mount, busted the doors open on the second floor. She jumped, leaning herself against the rails of the balcony, and screamed back “WHAT DADDY?”
7684de106b64.t: Hanya beberapa detik kemudian, kelihatannya, sosok humanoid merah muda yang familier, tetapi tidak lagi bersama tunggangan tepercayanya, mendobrak pintu di lantai dua. Ia melompat, mencondongkan tubuhnya ke pagar balkon, dan balas berteriak, “APA, PAPA?”

76c4b29d60d2.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body…
76c4b29d60d2.t: Seorang pria gemuk, yang bentuk tubuhnya pasti membutuhkan satu kursi untuk setiap bokongnya kalau ia mencoba naik kereta, duduk di kursi malas merah yang membentuk tubuhnya…

7958640f6b22.en: “King’s—maid?” A few steps in, and Harry was already out of breath.
7958640f6b22.t: “Pelayan—Raja?” Baru beberapa langkah, dan Harry sudah kehabisan napas.

79731df6d7c5.en: “Huh? Really?” Itagiba exchanged a quick glare with Neferteri.
79731df6d7c5.t: “Hah? Serius?” Itagiba bertukar tatapan singkat dengan Neferteri.

7a862c03974c.en: After moving her fingers around, and speaking under her breath unintelligibly, Nina shouted back “ELEVEN!”
7a862c03974c.t: Setelah menggerak-gerakkan jarinya, dan bergumam tak jelas, Nina balas berteriak, “SEBELAS!”

7be1839b59d1.en: Itagiba shook his head up-down with a nice self-important smile, pointing at himself with his own right thumb as if he was a political candidate posing for a poster.
7be1839b59d1.t: Itagiba mengangguk-angguk dengan senyum bangga diri yang manis, menunjuk dirinya sendiri dengan jempol kanannya seolah ia calon politikus yang berpose untuk poster.

7cf79571fb8b.en: Is that blood? He noticed the red stains on the wall meeting a pool of darker red liquid down on the floor. His thighs were still tensed up and sore, so he used his left hand on the bookshelf, and crouched down towards it like an old person—grunting like one as well. As he went down, the stranger’s nose pierced a cloud of stagnation; a rusty, slightly pungent air entered his lungs, making him nauseous. Stiffening his face, the stranger breathed out through his nose, trying to keep the odd smell at bay. “Oh, shit, it is!” He jumped back up like a skittish cat, his heart skipping a beat, and a primordial fear striking his core. His head moved around the room furiously, searching for an enemy he did not know existed. His squinting eyes quickly followed a trail of bloodied footprints from the pool near his feet that led out of the room, stepping on what appeared to be a fallen door. What should I do? What if they killed me?
7cf79571fb8b.t: Apa itu darah? Ia memperhatikan noda merah di dinding yang bertemu genangan cairan merah yang lebih gelap di lantai. Pahanya masih tegang dan pegal, jadi ia memakai tangan kirinya untuk bertumpu pada rak buku, dan berjongkok ke arah genangan itu seperti orang tua—sambil mengerang seperti orang tua juga. Saat turun, hidung orang asing itu menembus segumpal udara pengap; udara berkarat yang agak menyengat masuk ke paru-parunya, membuatnya mual. Menegangkan wajahnya, orang asing itu mengembuskan napas lewat hidung, berusaha menjauhkan bau aneh itu. “Oh, sial, memang darah!” Ia melompat bangun seperti kucing yang kaget, jantungnya berdegup tak beraturan, dan rasa takut purba menghantam intinya. Kepalanya bergerak liar ke seluruh ruangan, mencari musuh yang ia tidak tahu ada. Matanya yang menyipit dengan cepat mengikuti jejak kaki berdarah dari genangan di dekat kakinya yang mengarah keluar ruangan, menginjak sesuatu yang tampaknya pintu yang roboh. Apa yang harus kulakukan? Bagaimana kalau mereka membunuhku?

7d28c8a3a422.en: Discombobulated, Harry stood there, watching the king disappear. The words “Thank you?” slipped through his mouth, followed by a bead of sweat running down his forehead, imagining himself asking her. With one slow step after the other, Harry went back to his primary goal of walking up the mountain in the shape of spiraling stairs. So I can really just ask for that? Harry imagined her small hands washing his back, exactly where an actual itch started to appear in the middle of his back, right where his hands couldn’t reach. As he reached the third floor, he saw that she was not there. The floor itself looked the exact same as the tower he got off—a small room with two doors, except this time the doors were bright blue. Stepping into the stairs going to the fourth floor, he focused on how she would look as she brushed his back—perhaps with the same embarrassment from when he touched her hands, or perhaps with a willful determination like when she ran up the stairs? But isn’t that asking too much of her? Hmm. But if the king says it’s fine, then I guess it’s fine?
7d28c8a3a422.t: Kebingungan, Harry berdiri di sana, memandangi sang raja menghilang. Kata-kata “Terima kasih?” lolos dari mulutnya, disusul butiran keringat yang mengalir di dahinya, membayangkan dirinya memintanya. Dengan satu langkah pelan demi satu langkah, Harry kembali ke tujuan utamanya, mendaki gunung berbentuk tangga spiral itu. Jadi aku benar-benar bisa minta begitu saja? Harry membayangkan tangan mungilnya menggosok punggungnya, tepat di tempat rasa gatal yang sungguhan mulai muncul di tengah punggungnya, tepat di tempat yang tak terjangkau tangannya. Saat sampai di lantai tiga, ia melihat gadis itu tidak ada di sana. Lantai itu sendiri tampak persis sama dengan menara tempat ia keluar tadi—ruangan kecil dengan dua pintu, hanya saja kali ini pintunya berwarna biru cerah. Melangkah ke tangga menuju lantai empat, ia membayangkan bagaimana rupa gadis itu saat menggosok punggungnya—mungkin dengan rasa malu yang sama seperti saat ia menyentuh tangannya, atau mungkin dengan tekad bulat seperti saat ia berlari menaiki tangga? Tapi bukankah itu terlalu banyak menuntut darinya? Hmm. Tapi kalau raja bilang tidak apa-apa, berarti tidak apa-apa, kan?

7ea8dcb0fb6d.en: Harry bit his cheeks, looking at the odd time-keeping instrument. Maybe I am just remembering wrongly, then. With a slightly strained smile, he looked back at Sora. “Thank you for showing me all of this!”
7ea8dcb0fb6d.t: Harry menggigit pipinya, memandangi alat penunjuk waktu yang aneh itu. Mungkin aku saja yang salah ingat. Dengan senyum yang agak dipaksakan, ia kembali memandang Sora. “Terima kasih sudah menunjukkan semua ini!”

7f479e4c029a.en: Laughing out loud at the white bright light on the TV, the heavy man finished gulping down the beer, and with a lazy fling, he threw the bottle aside, careless to look, or bother where it would land; the bottle did not make a noise. Instead, it vanished into the darkness not soon after leaving his hands.
7f479e4c029a.t: Tertawa terbahak-bahak pada cahaya putih terang di TV, pria gemuk itu menghabiskan birnya, dan dengan lemparan malas, ia membuang botolnya ke samping, tak peduli untuk melihat, atau memikirkan di mana botol itu akan mendarat; botol itu tidak menimbulkan bunyi. Sebaliknya, botol itu lenyap ke dalam kegelapan tak lama setelah lepas dari tangannya.

80907259a3ce.en: As the stars disappeared from his vision, a memory appeared in the soft darkness of his vision; it was himself, seated in something comfortable, reddish in color, but he could not remember the details other than knowing it was a recliner.
80907259a3ce.t: Saat bintang-bintang itu menghilang dari penglihatannya, sebuah ingatan muncul dalam kegelapan lembut penglihatannya; itu dirinya sendiri, duduk di sesuatu yang nyaman, berwarna kemerahan, tetapi ia tidak bisa mengingat detailnya selain tahu bahwa itu sebuah kursi malas.

80e433984f15.en: “Your corpse was discovered in the slums by the guards. We were aware you would lose a few memories based on your advanced state of decay, yet it is unfortunate to hear that you lost far more than the average person would.” Neferteri spoke like a president on live TV reading from a teleprompter—rehearsed, slowly, clearly, but kinda emotionless.
80e433984f15.t: “Mayat Anda ditemukan di permukiman kumuh oleh para pengawal. Kami sadar Anda akan kehilangan beberapa ingatan mengingat tingkat pembusukan Anda yang sudah parah, namun sungguh disayangkan mendengar bahwa Anda kehilangan jauh lebih banyak daripada orang pada umumnya.” Neferteri berbicara seperti presiden di siaran langsung TV yang membaca dari teleprompter—terlatih, perlahan, jelas, tetapi agak tanpa emosi.

81df56355af1.en: Nina hurled herself to stand on top of the rails, and like a cheerleader, she began making weird hand signs with her hands and arms. The first was a rectangle shape above her head. She then said out loud “H!” The second transformed into a triangle shape, and then she said “A!” The third and fourth were a hand wave that went up, then down to the right in a forty-five-degree angle for a bit, then halfway back horizontally, up to the middle, then right horizontally.
81df56355af1.t: Nina melompat untuk berdiri di atas pagar, dan seperti pemandu sorak, ia mulai membuat isyarat tangan yang aneh dengan tangan dan lengannya. Yang pertama berupa bentuk persegi panjang di atas kepalanya. Lalu ia berseru, “H!” Yang kedua berubah menjadi bentuk segitiga, lalu ia berseru, “A!” Yang ketiga dan keempat berupa lambaian tangan yang naik, lalu turun ke kanan dengan sudut empat puluh lima derajat sebentar, lalu setengah jalan kembali secara horizontal, naik ke tengah, lalu ke kanan secara horizontal.

81ea1028b64a.en: “Well, what do you know?” The towering man in white cape let go of the stranger’s weak-ass grip. His question felt like a blunt weapon by the quick timing, but his intonation seemed pretty curious about it, rather than just feeling rude.
81ea1028b64a.t: “Yah, lalu apa yang kau tahu?” Pria jangkung bermantel putih itu melepaskan genggaman lemah orang asing itu. Pertanyaannya terasa seperti senjata tumpul karena waktunya yang cepat, tetapi intonasinya terdengar cukup penasaran, alih-alih sekadar kasar.

865151ffe148.en: Itagiba chuckled out loudly. “Ah—ah! Oooh! That’s great! I need to use that one someday.”
865151ffe148.t: Itagiba terkekeh keras. “Ah—ah! Oooh! Bagus banget! Suatu hari aku harus pakai yang itu.”

875fe750d7f6.en: Us? Harry’s mind searched its entire catalog of words, but nothing came up for it. Humans, yes, but not Naked Bruntos.
875fe750d7f6.t: Kita? Pikiran Harry mencari di seluruh katalog kata-katanya, tetapi tidak menemukan apa pun. Manusia, ya, tetapi bukan Naked Bruntos.

8a36816ed3ba.en: Letting out a faint exasperated sigh when the stones stopped rattling, Sora continued, bowing, “I’m sorry for my rudeness, sir Harry. This type of fost lamp is not meant to be hung, so it does not come with a cable. We do light it up for you every evening—” Noticing Harry’s puppy eyes, Sora continued. “But I can show you right now if you would like.”
8a36816ed3ba.t: Mengembuskan napas jengkel yang samar ketika batu-batu itu berhenti berkelotakan, Sora melanjutkan, sambil membungkuk, “Maafkan ketidaksopanan saya, Tuan Harry. Lampu fost jenis ini tidak dimaksudkan untuk digantung, jadi tidak dilengkapi tali. Kami memang menyalakannya untuk Anda setiap malam—” Menyadari mata memelas Harry, Sora melanjutkan. “Tapi saya bisa menunjukkannya sekarang juga kalau Anda mau.”

8b28647be40e.en: “Hey! Come on down!” A friendly voice caught his attention amongst the rustles of the city’s noises. Following the source of the voice, he saw the walls with a beautiful splash of flowery colors hugging its insides, separating the city from a green field with a large boxy castle in the middle. Right below him, he saw a patch of what looked like a splash of blood contrasting the beautiful green, with three adult humanoids in blue and golden hues standing around it. Meanwhile, zooming randomly around like a headless chicken, a small pink humanoid on top of a large, round black thing rushed by the purple-hair humanoid, nearly crashing against it. He could not make any details of what was happening, but he clearly heard the echo of a child's laughter, shrieks of a distressed bird, and a girly, somewhat angry, voice that screamed back “CUT IT OUT, NINA!”
8b28647be40e.t: “Hei! Ayo turun!” Sebuah suara ramah menarik perhatiannya di tengah riuh suara kota. Mengikuti sumber suara itu, ia melihat tembok-tembok dengan cipratan indah warna-warni bunga yang memeluk bagian dalamnya, memisahkan kota dari padang hijau dengan kastil besar berbentuk kotak di tengahnya. Tepat di bawahnya, ia melihat sepetak sesuatu yang tampak seperti cipratan darah yang kontras dengan hijau yang indah itu, dengan tiga humanoid dewasa bernuansa biru dan keemasan berdiri di sekelilingnya. Sementara itu, melesat ke sana kemari secara acak seperti ayam tanpa kepala, sosok humanoid kecil merah muda di atas benda hitam besar yang bulat bergegas melewati humanoid berambut ungu, nyaris menabraknya. Ia tidak bisa melihat detail apa pun tentang apa yang sedang terjadi, tetapi ia jelas mendengar gema tawa seorang anak, pekikan burung yang ketakutan, dan suara feminin yang agak marah balas berteriak, “HENTIKAN, NINA!”

8c804f29fad3.en: A sudden gleam appeared in the stranger’s eyes, focusing as much attention as he could muster to hear what Neferteri was about to say.
8c804f29fad3.t: Kilau mendadak muncul di mata orang asing itu, memusatkan perhatian sebanyak yang bisa ia kerahkan untuk mendengar apa yang akan dikatakan Neferteri.

8fdb4b36578a.en: “Morning, Sora! Yep, that’s him alright. He’s Harry by the way.” Itagiba gave off a cool smile, noticing where Sora was actually looking.
8fdb4b36578a.t: “Pagi, Sora! Yap, memang dia orangnya. Namanya Harry, ngomong-ngomong.” Itagiba tersenyum keren, menyadari ke mana Sora sebenarnya memandang.

92f5c8042d0e.en: Closing the odd-looking toilet, she cradled the fost lamp with her both hands. “Yes sir. Is there anything else you would like help with, sir Harry? The tub is ready for you.” Sora waved her hand towards the tub in the back of the bathroom, patiently waiting to strip Harry from his Bagarisa musk.
92f5c8042d0e.t: Menutup kloset yang tampak aneh itu, ia mendekap lampu fost dengan kedua tangannya. “Benar, Tuan. Apakah ada hal lain yang bisa saya bantu, Tuan Harry? Bak mandinya sudah siap untuk Anda.” Sora melambaikan tangannya ke arah bak mandi di bagian belakang kamar mandi, dengan sabar menunggu untuk melucuti Harry dari musk Bagarisa-nya.

95e89f96fc9e.en: “Sora, he’s talking about your Darfaries vein.” Itagiba tapped Harry on the shoulder. “Man, your eyes are really that bad, huh?”
95e89f96fc9e.t: “Sora, dia membicarakan urat Darfaries-mu.” Itagiba menepuk bahu Harry. “Bro, matamu memang separah itu, ya?”

966024760337.en: “Yo! You got a name?” The towering man in a blue fish-scale-covered tank top stood up in front of him, giving him his hand for a shake, and blocking the way to the cute girl with long purple hair. The amount of gold-colored clothing, plus the bluish crystals on his neck, gave him the appeal of a grandiose figure. His eyes sized the stranger’s overall body thickness, and total lack of sex appeal—or clothes for that matter.
966024760337.t: “Yo! Kau punya nama?” Pria jangkung berkaus tanpa lengan bersisik ikan biru itu berdiri di depannya, mengulurkan tangan untuk berjabat, dan menghalangi jalan ke gadis imut berambut ungu panjang itu. Banyaknya pakaian berwarna emas, ditambah kristal kebiruan di lehernya, memberinya kesan sosok yang agung. Matanya menaksir ketebalan tubuh orang asing itu secara keseluruhan, dan ketiadaan daya tarik seksnya sama sekali—atau pakaian, dalam hal ini.

9675dbb19b13.en: “Ew. I was not the one who requested such a corpulent thing,” Eori’s cold-sounding voice was elegant like her mother’s, yet just as blunt as her father’s.
9675dbb19b13.t: “Iih. Bukan aku yang meminta makhluk segemuk itu,” suara Eori yang terdengar dingin itu anggun seperti suara ibunya, namun sama blak-blakannya dengan ayahnya.

97f9dd38b387.en: Meanwhile, Harry was looking at her cutesy hand laid out in front of him. Feeling a sense of peer pressure from behind, plus his own desires, he gulped as he carefully held it with both hands. It was slender, but just as warm, and comforting as Princess Eori’s. Still being careful, he touched the Darfaries vein; its red bumpiness was warmer than the rest of her hand, and had a certain toughness to it, but as his finger pressed slightly on it, it gave way to its squishiness.
97f9dd38b387.t: Sementara itu, Harry memandangi tangan imut yang terulur di depannya.
