Merasakan tekanan dari belakang, ditambah keinginannya sendiri, ia menelan ludah saat dengan hati-hati memegangnya dengan kedua tangan. Tangan itu ramping, tetapi sama hangatnya, dan menenangkannya, seperti tangan Putri Eori. Masih berhati-hati, ia menyentuh urat Darfaries itu; tonjolan merahnya lebih hangat dari bagian tangannya yang lain, dan agak liat, tetapi saat jarinya menekannya sedikit, urat itu mengalah, terasa kenyal.

981cbb3c560d.en: Chapter II subchapter 2: a man lies on a table under a window, one arm raised, in a room spattered with blood.
981cbb3c560d.t: Bab II subbab 2: seorang pria terbaring di atas meja di bawah jendela, satu lengannya terangkat, di ruangan yang berceceran darah.

983c2e2501e6.en: The light stopped zooming around, and in the next second it struck him like a light cannon, taking away his senses.
983c2e2501e6.t: Cahaya itu berhenti melesat ke sana kemari, dan detik berikutnya menghantamnya seperti meriam cahaya, merenggut indra-indranya.

9927a95254b6.en: Itagiba let out a good hum. “Hmmm—you mentioned that before—what is that? Actually, never mind. Do me a solid and write down the recipe for Eiri, okay? I want to be surprised!”
9927a95254b6.t: Itagiba bergumam puas. “Hmmm—kau sudah menyebutnya tadi—itu apa? Eh, sudahlah. Tolong tuliskan resepnya untuk Eiri, ya? Aku mau dapat kejutan!”

99caa4d9a44d.en: Trying to keep some distance from the Bagarisa musk coming from Harry, Sora, standing at the door, placed her hand on the comfortable, leathery grayish-green couch. “Sir Harry—this is a couch—and you would use it to sit and read books and—” Sora trailed off mid-sentence, realizing Harry was looking elsewhere.
99caa4d9a44d.t: Berusaha menjaga jarak dari musk Bagarisa yang keluar dari Harry, Sora, berdiri di dekat pintu, meletakkan tangannya di sofa kulit hijau keabu-abuan yang nyaman itu. “Tuan Harry—ini sofa—dan Anda bisa memakainya untuk duduk dan membaca buku dan—” Sora berhenti di tengah kalimat, menyadari Harry sedang memandang ke tempat lain.

9a2d4884e5df.en: The stranger looked at himself, his skin completely fine. Plus he still had all limbs attached. But I am fine—Were they protecting me instead? But from what? What is this place anyway? Hmm?
9a2d4884e5df.t: Orang asing itu memandangi dirinya sendiri, kulitnya sama sekali baik-baik saja. Ditambah lagi semua anggota tubuhnya masih utuh. Tapi aku baik-baik saja—Apa mereka malah melindungiku? Tapi dari apa? Lagi pula tempat apa ini? Hmm?

9bf7cf73e81e.en: “That’s what she wants. So? Wanna marry her?” Itagiba cracked a wide smirk as his face was still right by the stranger’s, carefully watching for a response.
9bf7cf73e81e.t: “Itu yang dia mau. Jadi? Mau menikahinya?” Itagiba menyeringai lebar sementara wajahnya masih tepat di samping wajah orang asing itu, dengan cermat menunggu tanggapan.

9d57d62b8d3e.en: “—Dear. Hold. We need a name.” Neferteri softly spoke, calling to her husband as he was about to herd the stranger away. Meanwhile, the stranger smelled his hand, frowning as he noticed his nose had grown accustomed to his own musk.
9d57d62b8d3e.t: “—Sayang. Tunggu. Kita butuh nama.” Neferteri berbicara lembut, memanggil suaminya saat ia hendak menggiring orang asing itu pergi. Sementara itu, orang asing itu mencium tangannya, mengerutkan dahi saat menyadari hidungnya sudah terbiasa dengan musk-nya sendiri.

9e901329f96e.en: On what would be just another taco-beer-burp-taco-beer-taco-beer-fart-taco-beer loop, the white light began flickering the moment he was practicing playing his built-in smelly trombone. With blinking eyes, as if he had just come out of a long daydream, the corpulent man looked around; darkness to his left, darkness to his right, and darkness swallowing the backside. Everything around him was nothing but darkness. A feeling of being somewhere supposedly familiar, but yet feeling completely foreign gripped his insides; it was not another fart.
9e901329f96e.t: Di tengah apa yang seharusnya hanya satu lagi putaran taco-bir-sendawa-taco-bir-taco-bir-kentut-taco-bir, cahaya putih itu mulai berkedip-kedip tepat saat ia sedang berlatih memainkan trombon bau bawaannya. Dengan mata berkedip-kedip, seolah baru keluar dari lamunan panjang, pria gemuk itu melihat sekeliling; kegelapan di kirinya, kegelapan di kanannya, dan kegelapan menelan bagian belakang. Segala sesuatu di sekitarnya hanyalah kegelapan. Perasaan berada di tempat yang seharusnya familier, tetapi terasa sepenuhnya asing, mencengkeram isi perutnya; itu bukan kentut lagi.

a020a2c8f3c0.en: Harry used his hand to cover his eyes, stepping back from whatever Sora was doing. Soon after, the lamp light began to dwindle, including its steam output, leaving a faint bioluminescence. “WOW! That was cool! Huh—are the stones smaller now?”
a020a2c8f3c0.t: Harry memakai tangannya untuk menutupi matanya, mundur dari apa pun yang sedang dilakukan Sora. Tak lama kemudian, cahaya lampu itu mulai meredup, termasuk uap yang keluar, menyisakan bioluminesensi yang samar. “WOW! Keren banget! Hah—apa batunya jadi lebih kecil sekarang?”

a0b85159a429.en: Harry smiled, “Actually, yes, it’s just—some stuff looks weird to me. Like that. How's that a lamp?” Harry approached the supposed lamp, and picked it up. The top of the lamp had a hole about the size of a quarter, with two stones inside that had a glimmering radiance to them when inspected up close. How do you turn this on? Harry felt like there was something missing. “Don’t you have to, like, plug it or some—” He looked at the bottom of the lamp, rattling the stones inside as they clashed against the glass top. “There's no cable either—that’s weird.”
a0b85159a429.t: Harry tersenyum, “Sebenarnya, tahu, cuma—beberapa barang kelihatan aneh buatku. Seperti itu. Bagaimana itu bisa jadi lampu?” Harry mendekati benda yang katanya lampu itu, dan mengangkatnya. Bagian atas lampu itu punya lubang kira-kira seukuran koin, dengan dua batu di dalamnya yang memancarkan kilau ketika diperiksa dari dekat. Bagaimana cara menyalakannya? Harry merasa ada sesuatu yang kurang. “Bukannya harus, misalnya, dicolokkan atau sema—” Ia melihat bagian bawah lampu, membuat batu-batu di dalamnya berkelotakan saat beradu dengan kaca bagian atas. “Tidak ada kabelnya juga—aneh.”

a1527a8442fa.en: Meanwhile, Harry opened another drawer by the sink to put the timekeeper back, when he saw another familiar thing in purpose, but foreigner in aesthetic: a wooden toothbrush with red bristles, looking as if the bristles were pulled out of the back of some animal. By it, there was a fancy green porcelain jar with a greenish concoction inside that looked syrupy. Harry, placing the timekeeper back in a boxy wooden frame also inside the same drawer, grabbed the toothbrush, dipped it into the syrup, and brought it to his nose. A strong, but pleasant refreshing mint tickled it, then came the notes of green tea, and something citrusy about it. That’s an interesting toothpaste. Brushing a hearty amount of the syrup from the somewhat hard bristles on his tongue, it initially tasted something akin to nutmeg, then he felt as if someone punched him in the mouth. Ow fuck!—an explosion of flavor cocktail was so intense that most of his tongue grew numb. “Argh! Ow!”
a1527a8442fa.t: Sementara itu, Harry membuka laci lain di dekat wastafel untuk menyimpan kembali penunjuk waktu itu, ketika ia melihat benda lain yang familier fungsinya, tetapi asing tampilannya: sikat gigi kayu dengan bulu sikat merah, yang tampak seolah bulunya dicabut dari punggung suatu hewan. Di sebelahnya, ada toples porselen hijau yang mewah berisi ramuan kehijauan yang tampak seperti sirup. Harry, menaruh penunjuk waktu itu kembali di bingkai kayu berbentuk kotak yang juga ada di laci yang sama, mengambil sikat gigi itu, mencelupkannya ke sirup, dan mendekatkannya ke hidungnya. Aroma mint yang kuat namun menyegarkan dan menyenangkan menggelitik hidungnya, lalu muncul nuansa teh hijau, dan sesuatu yang bernuansa jeruk. Pasta gigi yang menarik. Menggosokkan sirup dalam jumlah banyak dari bulu sikat yang agak keras ke lidahnya, awalnya rasanya mirip pala, lalu ia merasa seolah seseorang meninju mulutnya. Aduh bangsat!—ledakan koktail rasa itu begitu hebat sampai sebagian besar lidahnya mati rasa. “Argh! Aduh!”

a28cbd9d11f6.en: “I—I—guess so?” A strained cutesy voice came out of Sora, feeling the pressure, and Bagarisa musk coming from Harry as she stepped closer, slowly extending one of her slightly shaking hands towards him.
a28cbd9d11f6.t: “S—s—saya kira bisa?” Suara imut yang tegang keluar dari Sora, merasakan tekanan, dan musk Bagarisa dari Harry saat ia melangkah mendekat, perlahan mengulurkan salah satu tangannya yang sedikit gemetar ke arahnya.

a3e9ef203150.en: “Tacos? The fuck is that?—Is it good?” The towering man interrupted the monologue with another verbal blunt strike.
a3e9ef203150.t: “Taco? Apaan tuh?—Enak tidak?” Pria jangkung itu memotong monolog itu dengan satu lagi pukulan verbal yang blak-blakan.

a3f07d51cdae.en: That’s not how faucets work, right? Harry looked at Sora, as she carefully watched the fost lamp get close to half full before pressing on the lever with all her might. Next, she took out the funnel, dried it with a towel, put it away, then from the same drawer she grabbed a glass jar, filled with a white fine grain—that coincidentally also had a built-in funnel almost the size of the fost lamp hole. “Is that salt?” Harry followed the white grains plopping into the water, and falling towards the bottom.
a3f07d51cdae.t: Keran tidak bekerja seperti itu, kan? Harry memandang Sora, yang dengan cermat memperhatikan lampu fost hampir terisi setengah sebelum menekan tuas dengan sekuat tenaga. Lalu, ia mencabut corong itu, mengeringkannya dengan handuk, menyimpannya, lalu dari laci yang sama ia mengambil sebuah toples kaca, berisi butiran putih halus—yang kebetulan juga punya corong bawaan hampir seukuran lubang lampu fost. “Apa itu garam?” Harry mengikuti butiran putih itu yang berjatuhan ke dalam air, dan tenggelam ke dasar.

a46a79e3e08f.en: She instead averted her eyes from him, fumbling her hands in front of an open blue door. “W–welcome to your guest room, sir Harry! I apologize for not bringing you proper clothes. Is there anything else you need?” Flushing red, but not as intensely as before, Sora peeked again at him, then back at the ground in front of him.
a46a79e3e08f.t: Ia malah mengalihkan pandangannya dari Harry, memainkan tangannya di depan pintu biru yang terbuka. “S–selamat datang di kamar tamu Anda, Tuan Harry! Saya mohon maaf karena tidak membawakan pakaian yang layak untuk Anda. Apakah ada lagi yang Anda butuhkan?” Merona merah, tetapi tidak sehebat sebelumnya, Sora mengintip lagi ke arahnya, lalu kembali menatap lantai di depannya.

a4a03a8d24fa.en: Nina, with her hand on her ears and somehow balancing herself purely on her stomach, nodded, then put up one finger with her left-hand, and four with the right-hand “TWENTY-SEVEN RAKUJAS!”
a4a03a8d24fa.t: Nina, dengan tangan di telinganya dan entah bagaimana menyeimbangkan dirinya hanya bertumpu pada perutnya, mengangguk, lalu mengangkat satu jari dengan tangan kirinya, dan empat dengan tangan kanannya, “DUA PULUH TUJUH RAKUJA!”

a4f2733c5b89.en: “Arrrrgggghhhh—hmph.” A loud burp nearly turned into vomit as this man’s stomach struggled with another horde of pig slop coming down his esophagus, but as soon as his stomach relented, he shoved down the last bite into his food hole. The saucy taco spilled down the sides of his mouth, then down his chin, and dripped on his chest.
a4f2733c5b89.t: “Arrrrgggghhhh—hmph.” Sendawa keras nyaris berubah menjadi muntahan saat perut pria ini bergulat dengan segerombolan makanan babi lagi yang turun ke kerongkongannya, tetapi begitu perutnya menyerah, ia menjejalkan gigitan terakhir ke lubang makannya. Taco yang penuh saus itu tumpah dari sudut-sudut mulutnya, lalu turun ke dagunya, dan menetes ke dadanya.

a756a1f83cc6.en: Neferteri softly smiled. “Dear, you do not recall anything about your persona? Not even a name?”
a756a1f83cc6.t: Neferteri tersenyum lembut. “Sayang, Anda tidak ingat apa pun tentang diri Anda? Bahkan nama pun tidak?”

a795d3f207fc.en: Stating in a lower, mischievous voice, the king spoke into Harry’s ear. “Take a peek at the rails going up.”
a795d3f207fc.t: Dengan suara yang lebih rendah dan nakal, sang raja berbicara di telinga Harry. “Coba intip pegangan tangga yang ke atas.”

a9802f0ea018.en: The stranger, feeling his sense of balance off, like he just got out of a rollercoaster, slowly stood up with his boxers in hand. Leaning his weight against the table, he put his feet through the holes, and started pulling the cloth up his legs. It felt quite comfortable at first with its higher quality breathable cotton rubbing on his skin, but as it got up closer to the waist, it certainly felt like it was not meant for him, leaving a clear imprint of his privates up front, and a slightly scratchy sensation on the stretchy fabric that rubbed on his waist.
a9802f0ea018.t: Orang asing itu, merasa keseimbangannya kacau, seperti baru turun dari roller coaster, perlahan berdiri dengan boxer di tangan. Menyandarkan berat badannya ke meja, ia memasukkan kakinya ke lubang-lubangnya, dan mulai menarik kain itu ke atas kakinya. Awalnya terasa cukup nyaman dengan katun berkualitas tinggi yang bisa bernapas menggesek kulitnya, tetapi begitu sampai dekat pinggang, jelas terasa bahwa itu bukan dibuat untuknya, meninggalkan cetakan jelas kemaluannya di depan, dan sensasi agak gatal dari kain elastis yang menggesek pinggangnya.

aa5231c4ce15.en: Looking as if someone jumped-scared her, Sora quickly looked at her hands and arms, then at her clothing—appearing as if she was performing some form of senseless postmodern choreography. With her blush waning, she slightly furrowed her brow and tilted her neck. “I’m sorry, sir Harry, but where am I bleeding?”
aa5231c4ce15.t: Tampak seolah seseorang baru saja mengagetkannya, Sora cepat-cepat melihat tangan dan lengannya, lalu pakaiannya—tampak seolah sedang menampilkan semacam koreografi postmodern yang tak masuk akal. Dengan rona merahnya yang memudar, ia sedikit mengerutkan dahi dan memiringkan lehernya. “Maafkan saya, Tuan Harry, tapi di mana saya berdarah?”

ac670eeefbe7.en: Itagiba waved his hand towards the stairs to let Harry walk up first. “King-maid. I will ask her to stop by and say hi. I mean, she would do that anyway.”
ac670eeefbe7.t: Itagiba melambaikan tangannya ke arah tangga agar Harry naik lebih dulu. “King-maid. Nanti kusuruh dia mampir dan menyapamu. Maksudku, dia juga bakal melakukannya sendiri.”

ad7a95acdc1d.en: He looked at his parents’ faces, but he could not see their expressions, or even how they looked. He looked back at the dog, but he was gone, and so were his parents. He now sat by himself, in a small apartment, looking much older than what he currently was.
ad7a95acdc1d.t: Ia memandang wajah orang tuanya, tetapi ia tidak bisa melihat ekspresi mereka, atau bahkan rupa mereka. Ia kembali memandang anjing itu, tetapi anjing itu sudah tiada, begitu juga orang tuanya. Kini ia duduk sendirian, di sebuah apartemen kecil, tampak jauh lebih tua dari usianya sekarang.

aee664a623c7.en: The stranger looked back and forth between the king and queen. Both were anxiously waiting for his response. He then glanced towards the beautiful princess, Eori, apparently busy looking at the flowers hugging the castle walls. I guess I can’t say no to this? They saved me after all. A nervous grin appeared on him as he imagined another princess in the same vein as the purple-haired one. “Yes!” the stranger said, with no further hesitation.
aee664a623c7.t: Orang asing itu memandang bolak-balik antara sang raja dan sang ratu. Keduanya menunggu jawabannya dengan cemas. Ia lalu melirik sang putri cantik, Eori, yang tampaknya sibuk memandangi bunga-bunga yang memeluk tembok kastil. Kurasa aku tidak bisa menolak ini? Lagi pula mereka sudah menyelamatkanku. Seringai gugup muncul di wajahnya saat ia membayangkan putri lain yang semacam putri berambut ungu itu. “Ya!” kata orang asing itu, tanpa ragu lagi.

b11c2d576cb0.en: “Shhh—she’s fine, see?” The king smiled, releasing the stranger. “CAN YOU GIVE HIM A NAME?” Itagiba loudly spoke to Nina.
b11c2d576cb0.t: “Ssst—dia baik-baik saja, lihat?” Sang raja tersenyum, melepaskan orang asing itu. “BISA KAU KASIH DIA NAMA?” Itagiba berbicara keras kepada Nina.

b1fc09a9585d.en: “Hahaha—that’s what you get,” Itagiba busted out a belly laugh, with Eori, the princess in purple, showing a pleasurable grin on her face as she held back a soft laughter.
b1fc09a9585d.t: “Hahaha—rasain,” Itagiba tertawa terbahak-bahak, sementara Eori, sang putri berbaju ungu, menunjukkan seringai puas di wajahnya sambil menahan tawa pelan.

b29a03784e4a.en: The stranger opened his burning eyes to a blinding light, barely recognizing a blurry white ceiling above him. The stranger felt the blood pumping in his veins, a steady heartbeat in his chest that pricked his extremities, and his back uncomfortably resting against something hard that felt slightly moist, sticky.
b29a03784e4a.t: Orang asing itu membuka matanya yang perih pada cahaya yang menyilaukan, nyaris tak mengenali langit-langit putih buram di atasnya. Orang asing itu merasakan darah memompa di pembuluh darahnya, detak jantung yang teratur di dadanya yang membuat ujung-ujung tubuhnya kesemutan, dan punggungnya yang bertumpu tidak nyaman pada sesuatu yang keras dan terasa agak basah, lengket.

b2e11d1a0fc4.en: With his heart rate up, beads of sweat formed on Harry’s forehead. His body looked as if it was climbing a mountain, but in reality he was just finishing the first flight of stairs.
b2e11d1a0fc4.t: Dengan detak jantung yang naik, butiran keringat terbentuk di dahi Harry. Tubuhnya tampak seperti sedang mendaki gunung, padahal kenyataannya ia baru saja menyelesaikan anak tangga pertama.

b41507ee13ec.en: The screen was a thin bezel TV that only showed a white bright light, with a constant noise, like what an old CRT used to make, but instead of a single high-pitched, ear-piercing noise, it sounded closer to heavy rain on a roof. However, if you paid close attention, it kinda felt like you could pick out a voice in a sea of voices, or an instrument within a thousand simultaneous orchestras.
b41507ee13ec.t: Layar itu adalah TV berbingkai tipis yang hanya menampilkan cahaya putih terang, dengan bunyi yang konstan, seperti yang dulu dibuat TV CRT tua, tetapi alih-alih satu bunyi melengking yang menusuk telinga, bunyinya lebih mirip hujan deras di atap. Namun, kalau kamu benar-benar memperhatikan, rasanya kamu seakan bisa menangkap satu suara di tengah lautan suara, atau satu instrumen di antara seribu orkestra yang bermain bersamaan.

b7e3035f1be4.en: Squinting his eyes hard, he tried to make out the room he was in. He saw a large—maybe broken—window, and a large splash of something red against the wall. Bookcases to the left and right of the window, and other wooden cabinets and a sink spread through the other walls—it had a strong utilitarian, doctor’s office appeal to it, especially with the table he was sitting at being dead-center in the room—the only thing it was missing were cringy posters of pharmaceutical companies trying to push medicine into patients, and a call-a-nurse button.
b7e3035f1be4.t: Menyipitkan matanya kuat-kuat, ia mencoba mengenali ruangan tempatnya berada. Ia melihat sebuah jendela besar—mungkin pecah—dan cipratan besar sesuatu yang merah di dinding. Rak buku di kiri dan kanan jendela, serta lemari kayu dan wastafel tersebar di dinding-dinding lain—ruangan itu sangat terasa fungsional, seperti ruang praktik dokter, apalagi dengan meja yang ia duduki tepat di tengah-tengah ruangan—satu-satunya yang kurang hanyalah poster-poster norak perusahaan farmasi yang berusaha menjejalkan obat ke pasien, dan tombol pemanggil perawat.

b8c23973dccd.en: Itagiba hugged the stranger from the side, ignoring the Bagarisa musk coming from him; he spoke with a straight face right up close to his. “You can bug Gabiro for the details when he’s back! He’s like the smartest—smartass too—scientist in the block! But you still haven’t asked why we resurrected you! So let me tell you straight—we want you to marry one of our princesses—even if you stink like a Bagarisa.”
b8c23973dccd.t: Itagiba memeluk orang asing itu dari samping, tak menghiraukan musk Bagarisa yang keluar darinya; ia berbicara dengan wajah serius tepat di dekat wajahnya. “Kau bisa merecoki Gabiro soal detailnya kalau dia sudah kembali! Dia itu ilmuwan paling pintar—paling sok pintar juga—di sini! Tapi kau belum tanya kenapa kami membangkitkanmu! Jadi biar kubilang terus terang—kami mau kau menikahi salah satu putri kami—walaupun kau bau seperti Bagarisa.”

bc30f86b7495.en: “Yes, sir.” Sora put away the odd-looking saltshaker. Meanwhile, the mostly dissolved grains of salt reached the stones in the bottom, making white light sparkle across it, and forming small bubbles. As the salt-rich water further enveloped the whitish stones, the sparkles of light began joining together into a dim light that grew steadier.
bc30f86b7495.t: “Benar, Tuan.” Sora menyimpan tempat garam yang tampak aneh itu. Sementara itu, butiran garam yang sebagian besar sudah larut mencapai batu-batu di dasar, membuat cahaya putih berkilauan di permukaannya, dan membentuk gelembung-gelembung kecil. Saat air yang kaya garam itu semakin menyelimuti batu-batu keputihan itu, kilau-kilau cahaya itu mulai menyatu menjadi cahaya redup yang semakin stabil.

bd47d190f680.en: “That’s my girl!” The king clapped with energy, of which Neferteri and Eori did not share.
bd47d190f680.t: “Itu baru anakku!” Sang raja bertepuk tangan penuh semangat, semangat yang tidak dimiliki Neferteri dan Eori.

bd7e15b70651.en: The TV, with its last flickering light, finally gave its last burst. The darkness, that forever waited patiently, now finally had the opportunity to strike.
bd7e15b70651.t: TV itu, dengan cahaya berkedip terakhirnya, akhirnya memancarkan semburan terakhirnya. Kegelapan, yang selamanya menunggu dengan sabar, kini akhirnya mendapat kesempatan untuk menyerang.

be7c074ee4d7.en: Harry looked around the room and saw a few wooden cabinets and two square containers—one with a lid that looked like a trashcan, and another that looked like a laundry basket. “Eh—I think I get the rest. Thanks again, Sora!”
be7c074ee4d7.t: Harry melihat sekeliling ruangan dan melihat beberapa lemari kayu dan dua wadah persegi—satu dengan tutup yang tampak seperti tempat sampah, dan satu lagi yang tampak seperti keranjang cucian. “Eh—kurasa sisanya aku paham. Terima kasih lagi, Sora!”

c0768cd3ac2f.en: A suppressed girly moan came out of the maid, Sora, while her body slightly shivered.
c0768cd3ac2f.t: Desahan feminin yang tertahan keluar dari si pelayan, Sora, sementara tubuhnya sedikit gemetar.

c0b3c9202afe.en: What is this place? He kept squinting as he looked for something familiar, but there was nothing amongst the pile of stuff thrown all over the place that hinted at it.
c0b3c9202afe.t: Tempat apa ini? Ia terus menyipitkan mata sambil mencari sesuatu yang familier, tetapi tidak ada apa pun di antara tumpukan barang yang berserakan di mana-mana yang memberi petunjuk.

c1e4fb287773.en: Looking towards the back of the room, Harry saw a window, and right below it, a neatly set, comfortable-looking single person bed. To the left of the room there was another normal-looking door, closed, and beside it a large painting of a guy, looking like an older version of Itagiba, fishing from the clouds while being pulled by an animal that looked like a horse. Below that painting, there was a desk with ink in five different hues: yellow, red, green, blue, and black, plus the same nari stone he had seen before, but now they were individually laid out neatly below the inks. “Can I ask what that is?” Harry’s eyes noticed a blur of a glass-and-wood lamp-looking thing with two whitish stones inside resting on top of a nightstand. “They are like—everywhere.”
c1e4fb287773.t: Memandang ke bagian belakang ruangan, Harry melihat sebuah jendela, dan tepat di bawahnya, sebuah ranjang satu orang yang tertata rapi dan tampak nyaman. Di sebelah kiri ruangan ada pintu lain yang tampak biasa, tertutup, dan di sampingnya ada lukisan besar seorang pria, yang tampak seperti Itagiba versi lebih tua, sedang memancing dari awan sambil ditarik oleh hewan yang tampak seperti kuda. Di bawah lukisan itu, ada meja tulis dengan tinta lima warna berbeda: kuning, merah, hijau, biru, dan hitam, ditambah batu nari yang sama seperti yang ia lihat sebelumnya, tetapi kini diletakkan satu per satu dengan rapi di bawah tinta-tinta itu. “Boleh aku tanya itu apa?” Mata Harry memperhatikan sosok buram benda mirip lampu dari kaca dan kayu dengan dua batu keputihan di dalamnya yang diletakkan di atas meja samping ranjang. “Benda itu ada—di mana-mana.”

c2b615a129bb.en: The other floor below was the exact same, except there were faint bloody footprints from the bottom stairs going into the main door. The stranger, feeling as if he was being peer pressured, even though there were no peers around him, stepped closer to the door, only to hear a constant beating rhythm—like an eagerly quickening clap. His hand clenched to a fist, ready to knock at the door, but looking at the bloodied footprints, his face clenched as well, making his hand avoid the mysteriousness of that side quest.
c2b615a129bb.t: Lantai di bawahnya lagi persis sama, hanya saja ada jejak kaki berdarah samar dari anak tangga terbawah yang masuk ke pintu utama. Orang asing itu, merasa seperti ditekan teman sebaya, padahal tidak ada teman sebaya di sekitarnya, melangkah mendekati pintu itu, hanya untuk mendengar irama ketukan yang konstan—seperti tepukan yang makin bersemangat dan makin cepat. Tangannya mengepal, siap mengetuk pintu, tetapi melihat jejak kaki berdarah itu, wajahnya ikut mengencang, membuat tangannya menghindari misteri side quest itu.

c58f4746ab79.en: The darker skinned lady came closer to the towering men and put her hand on his left shoulder. “Honey, let him speak.” Her eyes glared at the stranger as well, appearing to analyze everything he said, or did, maybe even how quickly he was breathing.
c58f4746ab79.t: Wanita berkulit lebih gelap itu mendekati pria jangkung itu dan meletakkan tangannya di bahu kirinya. “Sayang, biarkan dia bicara.” Matanya juga menatap tajam orang asing itu, tampak menganalisis semua yang ia katakan, atau lakukan, bahkan mungkin seberapa cepat ia bernapas.

c6be0c4d3e8e.en: “But Mom! This fatso looks like him!” Nina had a sweet, innocent tone to her childish voice, but her devious grin contrasted it like day and night.
c6be0c4d3e8e.t: “Tapi Ma! Si gendut ini mirip dia!” Nina berbicara dengan nada manis dan polos dalam suara kekanak-kanakannya, tetapi seringai liciknya bertolak belakang bagai siang dan malam.

c787ee3df9f9.en: “Yeah. She takes care of the maids, and the accounting of the kingdom,” Itagiba replied without thinking, as if this answer has been given to people many times.
c787ee3df9f9.t: “Iya. Dia mengurus para pelayan, dan pembukuan kerajaan,” jawab Itagiba tanpa berpikir, seolah jawaban ini sudah sering diberikan kepada banyak orang.

c788c7632db9.en: Marry one of our princesses. Itagiba’s words echoed in the stranger’s brain, unable to be processed, not because he couldn’t, but rather he never thought those words would be spoken. His brain, stuck on a BSOD, did not give any further instructions, so he was stuck in a paralyzed blinking motion until a ding occurred when his brain finally rebooted. His jaw dropped, and he immediately turned his head towards Eori’s beautiful face—his blue eyes widened so much it was about to fall from his eye sockets.
c788c7632db9.t: Menikahi salah satu putri kami. Kata-kata Itagiba bergema di otak orang asing itu, tak bisa diproses, bukan karena ia tidak mampu, melainkan karena ia tak pernah mengira kata-kata itu akan diucapkan. Otaknya, macet di layar biru BSOD, tidak memberi instruksi apa pun lagi, jadi ia terjebak dalam gerakan berkedip yang lumpuh sampai terdengar bunyi ding ketika otaknya akhirnya reboot. Rahangnya ternganga, dan ia segera menoleh ke wajah cantik Eori—mata birunya terbelalak begitu lebar sampai hampir jatuh dari rongganya.

c84205aca9a1.en: The stranger felt like he was punched in the liver when Eori said ew, but that was only the start of it. With the rest of her eloquent speech, he felt like she, emotionally speaking, had just given him a fatality combo, akin to the gruesome, spine-ripping ones found in popular combat games. He could not muster anything to reply back, for he also felt locked in place by Itagiba’s strong arm around his neck.
c84205aca9a1.t: Orang asing itu merasa seperti ditinju di hati ketika Eori berkata iih, tetapi itu baru permulaan. Dengan sisa pidatonya yang fasih, ia merasa seolah gadis itu, secara emosional, baru saja memberinya kombo fatality, seperti yang mengerikan dan mencabut tulang belakang di game pertarungan populer. Ia tidak bisa mengumpulkan apa pun untuk membalas, karena ia juga merasa terkunci di tempat oleh lengan kuat Itagiba yang melingkari lehernya.

c8acb1ac8836.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body perfectly, as if he had used it for an eternity. Behind thick square glasses, dirty with his own oily grimy skin, his eyes looked fervently at a white screen; no different than a deer looking at a truck’s headlight, moments away from experiencing the thrill of sudden change of momentum.
c8acb1ac8836.t: Seorang pria gemuk, yang bentuk tubuhnya pasti membutuhkan satu kursi untuk setiap bokongnya kalau ia mencoba naik kereta, duduk di kursi malas merah yang membentuk tubuhnya dengan sempurna, seolah ia sudah memakainya selama-lamanya. Di balik kacamata persegi tebal, kotor oleh kulitnya sendiri yang berminyak dan dekil, matanya menatap tekun ke sebuah layar putih; tidak ada bedanya dengan rusa yang menatap lampu depan truk, beberapa saat sebelum merasakan sensasi perubahan momentum yang mendadak.

ca3d4e4bd06e.en: “Dear, please tell us everything you might remember. You can trust us.” She extended her hand as well, briefly meeting the stranger’s. “For I am Neferteri Sanbi Royal, the queen of Sanbi, and this is the king, Itagiba Sanbi Royal.”
ca3d4e4bd06e.t: “Sayang, tolong ceritakan kepada kami semua yang mungkin Anda ingat. Anda bisa memercayai kami.” Ia juga mengulurkan tangannya, sejenak bertemu dengan tangan orang asing itu. “Karena saya adalah Neferteri Sanbi Royal, ratu Sanbi, dan ini sang raja, Itagiba Sanbi Royal.”

cb1d77f5ab71.en: Sora, looking at the tip of her middle and ring fingers, took note of the red vein-like pattern that bumped out of her virgin skin. She carefully watched the vein appear from the tip of her fingers towards the back of the hand where it merged into a larger vein as it continued down her forearm. She pulled on her black sleeve, revealing the same larger red vein-like thing going all the way up her forearm, getting as thick as a pencil with additional branches coming off the large vein.
cb1d77f5ab71.t: Sora, memandangi ujung jari tengah dan jari manisnya, memperhatikan pola merah seperti urat yang menonjol dari kulitnya yang perawan. Ia dengan cermat memperhatikan urat itu muncul dari ujung jari-jarinya ke punggung tangan, di mana urat itu menyatu dengan urat yang lebih besar yang terus berlanjut ke lengan bawahnya. Ia menarik lengan bajunya yang hitam, memperlihatkan urat merah besar yang sama terus naik sampai lengan bawahnya, menebal setebal pensil dengan cabang-cabang tambahan yang keluar dari urat besar itu.

cb34b7f0d313.en: The stranger clapped as well, trying to follow the same enthusiastic fatherly energy, but he was offbeat, for his concentration was also divided in noticing how the queen and Eori behaved indifferently to this spectacle.
cb34b7f0d313.t: Orang asing itu ikut bertepuk tangan, mencoba mengikuti energi kebapakan yang sama antusiasnya, tetapi tepukannya tidak seirama, karena konsentrasinya juga terbagi untuk memperhatikan bagaimana sang ratu dan Eori bersikap acuh tak acuh terhadap tontonan ini.

cb3f2af9ecd6.en: “Yes, sir. Right now it is Sunnolow, which is why that half timehunk is lit up. When the other half lights up instead, it will be Sunnohigh. Please make yourself at home—and, sir Harry—please enjoy your bath!” Sora ended with a tone as if she was pleading her case to a policeman, right before being arrested. “—there is plenty of time until Monnalow!” Sora, holding her nose away from Harry, looked away, fidgeting with her hands, ashamed of what she was trying to say.
cb3f2af9ecd6.t: “Benar, Tuan. Sekarang adalah Sunnolow, itulah sebabnya setengah timehunk itu menyala. Ketika setengah yang lain yang menyala, berarti Sunnohigh. Silakan anggap seperti rumah sendiri—dan, Tuan Harry—silakan nikmati mandi Anda!” Sora mengakhiri dengan nada seolah sedang memohon pembelaan kepada polisi, tepat sebelum ditangkap. “—masih banyak waktu sampai Monnalow!” Sora, menjauhkan hidungnya dari Harry, membuang muka, memainkan tangannya dengan gelisah, malu dengan apa yang hendak ia katakan.

cbf2b34bf806.en: Harry squinted back at Eori, trying to steal a last glance of her, but saw her looking firmly at him, almost with a suspicious gaze, before hiding her face away from him.
cbf2b34bf806.t: Harry menyipitkan mata ke arah Eori, mencoba mencuri pandang terakhir kepadanya, tetapi melihat gadis itu menatapnya tajam, hampir dengan tatapan curiga, sebelum menyembunyikan wajahnya darinya.

cd39af7ebcca.en: “My pleasure, sir Harry. A maid will bring you some tea on Sunnohigh.” Sora excused herself again, and made her way out of the room, closing the bathroom door.
cd39af7ebcca.t: “Dengan senang hati, Tuan Harry. Seorang pelayan akan membawakan teh untuk Anda pada Sunnohigh.” Sora pamit lagi, dan keluar dari ruangan, menutup pintu kamar mandi.

cd81b13016fa.en: Prepping to get off the table, he looked down on his lap, and saw a white cloth with red stars embroidered suspiciously covering his manhood. His inquisitive eyes turned to the cloth, realizing it was a pair of boxers. That’s not mine—actually, this seems kinda small. Wait a minute! My dick! I can see it now? His jaw dropped while his hands reached to his not-as-swollen gut, grabbing the no-longer-as-thick-and-juicy blabber folds of his bottom belly. How did I lose all this weight?—or was I even that fat to begin with?
cd81b13016fa.t: Bersiap turun dari meja, ia menunduk melihat pangkuannya, dan melihat sehelai kain putih dengan bordiran bintang-bintang merah yang dengan mencurigakan menutupi kejantanannya. Matanya yang penuh tanya beralih ke kain itu, menyadari bahwa itu sepasang celana dalam boxer. Itu bukan punyaku—sebenarnya, ini kelihatannya agak kecil. Tunggu sebentar! Kontolku! Sekarang aku bisa melihatnya? Rahangnya ternganga sementara tangannya meraih perutnya yang tidak lagi sebuncit dulu, mencengkeram lipatan lemak di perut bawahnya yang tidak lagi setebal dan selembek dulu. Bagaimana berat badanku bisa turun sebanyak ini?—atau apa aku memang segemuk itu dari awal?

cef8e04adbab.en: Harry looked back to the toilet, still with the time-keeping instrument in his hand. How do I know that’s a toilet, but not this time thingy? Was I born here? Amidst his thoughts, Itagiba’s voice came back to him. Soul Death. Opening his eyes wide, Harry remembered a piece of convo that slipped out of Itagiba’s mouth, which did not even register initially. So, the soul does exist—a toothbrush?
cef8e04adbab.t: Harry kembali memandang kloset, masih dengan alat penunjuk waktu di tangannya. Bagaimana aku tahu itu kloset, tapi tidak tahu benda waktu ini? Apa aku lahir di sini? Di tengah pikirannya, suara Itagiba kembali kepadanya. Kematian jiwa. Membuka matanya lebar-lebar, Harry teringat sepotong percakapan yang terlontar dari mulut Itagiba, yang bahkan tidak tercerna pada awalnya. Jadi, jiwa itu memang ada—sikat gigi?

d39876e47b32.en: Puffing, and huffing, Harry pushed his feet upstairs one at a time. His heart, pounding on his neck, as beads of sweat ran down his Bagarisa-musk-soaked skin.
d39876e47b32.t: Terengah-engah, Harry mendorong kakinya naik satu per satu. Jantungnya berdebar di lehernya, sementara butiran keringat mengalir di kulitnya yang basah oleh musk Bagarisa.

d48351a75f0a.en: “Attaboy! Now come with me! I can’t have you smelling like a bagarisa’s asshole when you meet her!” Itagiba let him go, and gestured his hand towards the farthest-off tower.
d48351a75f0a.t: “Nah, gitu dong! Sekarang ikut aku! Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu bau seperti lubang pantat bagarisa waktu ketemu dia!” Itagiba melepaskannya, dan menunjuk dengan tangannya ke arah menara yang paling jauh.

d488935c5387.en: “Naked Bruntos?” Harry furrowed his brow. “Sorry, I’m confused—”
d488935c5387.t: “Naked Bruntos?” Harry mengerutkan dahi. “Maaf, aku bingung—”

d5e23f994ae1.en: However, amongst the remaining memories, not as yet faded, he saw himself holding a knife against his own chest as he sobbed. He did not look as fat, but he did look just as worn out. Dropping the knife back in the kitchen counter, he felt misery, emptiness, yet a faint hope. He wanted to live because of that single thread of hope, but the sweet relief of death kept gnawing at it.
d5e23f994ae1.t: Namun, di antara ingatan-ingatan yang tersisa, yang belum memudar, ia melihat dirinya memegang pisau di depan dadanya sendiri sambil terisak. Ia tidak tampak segemuk itu, tetapi tampak sama lelahnya. Menjatuhkan pisau itu kembali ke meja dapur, ia merasakan kesengsaraan, kehampaan, namun juga secercah harapan. Ia ingin hidup karena seutas harapan itu, tetapi manisnya kelegaan kematian terus menggerogotinya.

d9cc5f83fa5d.en: “Nina!” A woman of dark skin and long black hair spoke with a firm motherly tone as her eyes stared daggers back at the child in pink.
d9cc5f83fa5d.t: “Nina!” Seorang wanita berkulit gelap dan berambut hitam panjang berbicara dengan nada keibuan yang tegas sementara matanya menatap tajam anak berbaju merah muda itu.

d9d3a13081b9.en: The sheer panic in her voice made Harry anxious as well. “The—the red thing on—on the back of your hand? Yeah! That!” Harry gestured with his hands to replicate where he was seeing the supposed blood.
d9d3a13081b9.t: Kepanikan dalam suaranya membuat Harry ikut cemas. “Itu—itu yang merah di—di punggung tanganmu? Iya! Itu!” Harry memperagakan dengan tangannya di mana ia melihat yang ia kira darah itu.

d9e218dd10ca.en: Feeling compelled to know more, the stranger made his way out of the room. Near the entrance, he saw a broken glass and wooden container that had two white stones within it. It was blurry, but he could see glass shards littered around it. Leaving that aside, he carefully placed his weight on the wobbly fallen door, only to see more glass-looking things with more whitish stones inside hanging from the ceiling as if it was a lamp. That’s weird. The stranger squinted his eyes as he passed underneath it towards the stairs.
d9e218dd10ca.t: Merasa terdorong untuk tahu lebih banyak, orang asing itu berjalan keluar ruangan. Di dekat pintu masuk, ia melihat sebuah wadah kaca dan kayu yang pecah berisi dua batu putih. Buram, tetapi ia bisa melihat pecahan kaca berserakan di sekitarnya. Mengabaikan itu, ia dengan hati-hati menaruh berat badannya di atas pintu roboh yang goyah, hanya untuk melihat lebih banyak benda mirip kaca dengan batu-batu keputihan di dalamnya, tergantung dari langit-langit seolah itu lampu. Aneh. Orang asing itu menyipitkan mata saat lewat di bawahnya menuju tangga.

da607efa0ef7.en: Chapter II subchapter 3: several people stand around a large dead black bird in a courtyard, including Harry in starred shorts.
da607efa0ef7.t: Bab II subbab 3: beberapa orang berdiri mengelilingi bangkai burung hitam besar di halaman, termasuk Harry yang memakai celana pendek berbintang.

ddd3d5c1025f.en: Is that a letter, too? The stranger felt an odd sensation as he felt Nina initially monkey around looking like she had a stroke, but as soon as she finished a stream of weird line motions, somehow the meaning of it made sense in his head. R? Is that really R?
ddd3d5c1025f.t: Apa itu huruf juga? Orang asing itu merasakan sensasi aneh saat ia merasa Nina awalnya bertingkah seperti monyet seolah terkena stroke, tetapi begitu ia menyelesaikan rangkaian gerakan garis yang aneh itu, entah bagaimana maknanya masuk akal di kepalanya. R? Apa itu benar-benar R?

e056ac8a60f1.en: Itagiba, with an increasingly devilish look, switched to a smoother tone. “Can you show it to him?”
e056ac8a60f1.t: Itagiba, dengan wajah yang semakin licik, beralih ke nada yang lebih halus. “Bisa kau tunjukkan padanya?”

e0c95b87145d.en: The fat man felt the darkness pulling him away from it, hiding him, consuming the rest of him like he was trapped in the belly of a beast. Just like the sensation he had when he pointed the knife at his own chest, despair and misery took over, but with it a nearly shredded thread of hope. “I DON’T WANNA DIE!” he screamed, but no sound came out. Sobbing like a baby, his hand moved towards the light.
e0c95b87145d.t: Pria gemuk itu merasakan kegelapan menariknya menjauh dari cahaya itu, menyembunyikannya, melahap sisa dirinya seolah ia terperangkap di perut seekor binatang buas. Persis seperti sensasi yang ia rasakan saat mengarahkan pisau ke dadanya sendiri, keputusasaan dan kesengsaraan mengambil alih, tetapi bersamanya ada seutas harapan yang nyaris putus. “AKU TIDAK MAU MATI!” teriaknya, tetapi tak ada suara yang keluar. Terisak seperti bayi, tangannya bergerak ke arah cahaya itu.

e0d51c436a88.en: “Please!” Harry’s eyes shone in a glimmering radiance just like the whitish stones.
e0d51c436a88.t: “Tolong!” Mata Harry bersinar dengan kilau yang memancar persis seperti batu-batu keputihan itu.

e157181e02f7.en: *One, two, three—*Using his finger, Harry counted a total of sixteen sections. The numbers look off. He looked at Sora, playing with her hands, as her black shoes and torso pointed to the door, apparently eager to leave the bathroom for some reason—possibly because of the lingering Bagarisa stench growing stronger. “Isn’t there like twenty-four hours?”
e157181e02f7.t: *Satu, dua, tiga—*Dengan jarinya, Harry menghitung total enam belas bagian. Angkanya terasa janggal. Ia memandang Sora, yang memainkan tangannya, sementara sepatu hitam dan tubuhnya mengarah ke pintu, tampaknya ingin segera meninggalkan kamar mandi karena suatu alasan—mungkin karena bau busuk Bagarisa yang tertinggal semakin kuat. “Bukannya ada sekitar dua puluh empat jam?”

e218b256d87a.en: Sora, now the one huffing as she grabbed the half-full fost lamp out of the sink, used all her strength to shake the water to properly mix it, turning the dim lamp into a little sun that lit the bathroom in pure, blinding white light, alongside a steam noise that sounded like a tea kettle about to boil.
e218b256d87a.t: Sora, kini dia yang terengah-engah saat mengambil lampu fost yang terisi setengah dari wastafel, mengerahkan seluruh tenaganya untuk mengocok air agar tercampur dengan baik, mengubah lampu redup itu menjadi matahari kecil yang menerangi kamar mandi dengan cahaya putih murni yang menyilaukan, disertai bunyi uap yang terdengar seperti ceret teh yang hampir mendidih.

e23b45472f9f.en: I—guess so? The stranger felt his tense shoulders relaxing, “Thank you!”
e23b45472f9f.t: Aku—kurasa begitu? Orang asing itu merasakan bahunya yang tegang mengendur, “Terima kasih!”

e6d7882d0c64.en: “Nice to meet you, sir Harry.” Sora glanced towards Harry quickly, then held her cutesy hands in front of her as she bowed slightly. “I’m Sora Sanbi Blue-glass!”
e6d7882d0c64.t: “Senang bertemu dengan Anda, Tuan Harry.” Sora melirik Harry sekilas, lalu menangkupkan tangannya yang imut di depannya sambil sedikit membungkuk. “Saya Sora Sanbi Blue-glass!”

e717b4291596.en: Extending her hands as far as she could towards Harry, she acquired the lamp from him, then opened the normal-looking door to the side, revealing it was a modest-looking bathroom. Placing the fost lamp on a nearby sink, she opened a nearby drawer, picked up a wood funnel, and jammed its near perfect fit on the small top hole of the lamp that itself aligned up to a hole from the pipe in the wall. Stretching her arm towards a handle in the same pipe, she pulled on it with a bit of force, causing water to angrily rush out from the hole, into the funnel, shockingly gargling its way into the fost lamp—if Poseidon was ever waterboarded by a three-letter agency, it would probably sound like that.
e717b4291596.t: Mengulurkan tangannya sejauh mungkin ke arah Harry, ia mengambil lampu itu darinya, lalu membuka pintu yang tampak biasa di samping, memperlihatkan bahwa itu kamar mandi yang tampak sederhana. Meletakkan lampu fost di wastafel terdekat, ia membuka laci di dekatnya, mengambil corong kayu, dan menjejalkannya, nyaris pas sempurna, ke lubang kecil di atas lampu itu, yang sendiri sejajar dengan lubang pipa di dinding. Merentangkan lengannya ke arah tuas di pipa yang sama, ia menariknya dengan sedikit tenaga, membuat air menyembur marah dari lubang itu, ke dalam corong, berdeguk mengejutkan masuk ke lampu fost—kalau Poseidon pernah di-waterboarding oleh badan intelijen, mungkin bunyinya seperti itu.

e907867f39ee.en: Biting the inside of his cheek, the stranger shook his head. “I’m sorry, but I just don’t know.”
e907867f39ee.t: Menggigit bagian dalam pipinya, orang asing itu menggeleng. “Maaf, tapi aku benar-benar tidak tahu.”

ea18ff71c955.en: Sora nodded, giggling as she glanced at Harry, looking like a kid in a ball pit for the first time. “Hehe—please don’t tell Eiri, but I knew you would appreciate it, sir Harry!” She opened the top of a boxy-looking thing, revealing a familiar looking bathroom staple, a toilet. The toilet also had an attached pipe that ran up the wall with a similar handle as the other pipe.
ea18ff71c955.t: Sora mengangguk, cekikikan sambil melirik Harry, yang tampak seperti anak kecil di kolam bola untuk pertama kalinya. “Hehe—tolong jangan bilang Eiri, tapi saya tahu Anda pasti akan menyukainya, Tuan Harry!” Ia membuka bagian atas sebuah benda berbentuk kotak, memperlihatkan perlengkapan kamar mandi yang tampak familier, sebuah kloset. Kloset itu juga punya pipa yang terpasang naik ke dinding dengan tuas yang mirip pipa yang lain.

ea9ba9d1cf4f.en: The stranger could not see well, but he did see enough to feel a sense of impending doom; imagining this tiny girl falling, and splattering in the grass down below. A peak of energy rushed his body. He attempted to take off after her, but the king held him at the shoulder.
ea9ba9d1cf4f.t: Orang asing itu tidak bisa melihat dengan jelas, tetapi ia melihat cukup banyak untuk merasakan malapetaka yang akan datang; membayangkan gadis mungil ini jatuh, dan hancur berceceran di rumput di bawah. Lonjakan energi menerjang tubuhnya. Ia mencoba berlari ke arahnya, tetapi sang raja menahan bahunya.

eb05898cbe04.en: Nothing strange happened, and with the certainty that he was relaxing in a bathtub, his shoulders involuntarily dropped, succumbing to the comforting warmth. With the tension melting away, it was time for his belly to rumble with an important request, one he could not deny as his intestines now felt like someone was twisting them. Harry let out a grunt, his face contorting as the twisting got lower and lower in his gut, followed by a small explosion in the water, making the whole tub vibrate like a phone ringing on a wooden table. The next second, a large bubble popped in the surface of the water, and with it the stench of death cursed the air around, far more pungent than a Bagarisa’s musk. With a blanching face, he tried to fan the smell outwards, but it was not enough. Turning his head towards the window, he sloppily attacked it with one hand, luckily making it open outwardly.
eb05898cbe04.t: Tidak ada yang aneh terjadi, dan dengan kepastian bahwa ia sedang bersantai di bak mandi, bahunya merosot tanpa sadar, menyerah pada kehangatan yang menenangkan. Dengan ketegangan yang mencair, tibalah waktunya perutnya bergemuruh dengan permintaan penting, yang tidak bisa ia tolak karena ususnya kini terasa seperti dipelintir seseorang. Harry mengerang, wajahnya berkerut saat pelintiran itu turun semakin rendah di perutnya, disusul ledakan kecil di dalam air, membuat seluruh bak mandi bergetar seperti ponsel yang berdering di atas meja kayu. Detik berikutnya, gelembung besar pecah di permukaan air, dan bersamanya bau kematian mengutuk udara di sekitarnya, jauh lebih menyengat daripada musk Bagarisa. Dengan wajah memucat, ia mencoba mengipas-ngipas bau itu keluar, tetapi tidak cukup. Menoleh ke arah jendela, ia menyerangnya dengan asal-asalan memakai satu tangan, untungnya membuat jendela itu terbuka ke luar.

ed359447198a.en: Itagiba turned his head towards the castle. “HEY NINA!” he screamed at the top of his lungs.
ed359447198a.t: Itagiba menoleh ke arah kastil. “HEI NINA!” teriaknya sekeras-kerasnya.

f1027aa5b770.en: Chapter II - Stranger · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
f1027aa5b770.t: Bab II - Orang Asing · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

f1aff528ae77.en: “DEAL!” Itagiba let out a laugh through his nose, while his face remained business casual.
f1aff528ae77.t: “SETUJU!” Itagiba tertawa lewat hidungnya, sementara wajahnya tetap santai ala urusan bisnis.

f2c924f9b5d7.en: A playful balance with his life threaded on that same line.
f2c924f9b5d7.t: Keseimbangan yang main-main dengan hidupnya, terajut pada benang yang sama.

f3c74c9779d5.en: Neferteri and Eori both stood back. Eori kept averting her gaze, while Neferteri smiled as she carefully sized up, or rather analyzed, Harry as he was taken away by Itagiba.
f3c74c9779d5.t: Neferteri dan Eori sama-sama tetap di tempat. Eori terus mengalihkan pandangannya, sementara Neferteri tersenyum sambil dengan cermat menaksir, atau lebih tepatnya menganalisis, Harry saat ia dibawa pergi oleh Itagiba.

f64b1966980f.en: Pulling the goth chicken’s head feathers around as if it was a joystick, Nina, still mounted on the bird, stepped closer to the stranger. With her small cutesy right hand up in the air, she clearly wanted a high-five. The stranger took a second or so to realize her request, and as his hand went to high-five her tiny hands, she bamboozled him by slipping it downwards, and used it as a poking stick into his belly button. Spitting all over, she made a wet fart sound with her mouth. “Pfffff—ewww it’s wet!” Dropping her act, she quickly took out her finger, and, for no apparent reason, put it up right below her nose, only to take a deep whiff, and gag profusely from the je ne sais quoi smell of Bagarisa musk.
f64b1966980f.t: Menarik-narik bulu kepala ayam goth itu seolah itu joystick, Nina, masih menunggangi burung itu, mendekati orang asing itu. Dengan tangan kanannya yang mungil dan imut terangkat ke udara, ia jelas ingin tos. Orang asing itu butuh satu detik atau lebih untuk menyadari permintaannya, dan saat tangannya hendak bertos dengan tangan mungil Nina, gadis kecil itu mengecohnya dengan menyelipkan tangannya ke bawah, dan memakainya sebagai tongkat penyodok ke pusarnya. Sambil menyembur ke mana-mana, ia membuat bunyi kentut basah dengan mulutnya. “Pfffff—iii basah!” Menghentikan aksinya, ia cepat-cepat mencabut jarinya, dan, tanpa alasan yang jelas, menaruhnya tepat di bawah hidungnya, lalu menghirupnya dalam-dalam, dan tersedak hebat oleh bau musk Bagarisa yang je ne sais quoi.

f69a61097a30.en: For a moment, the king of Sanbi appeared to hold back wanting to say something. His concerned eyes then disappeared, pushing Harry to keep going upstairs. “One more! We can do it! Let’s go!”
f69a61097a30.t: Sejenak, raja Sanbi itu tampak menahan diri untuk mengatakan sesuatu. Mata khawatirnya lalu menghilang, mendorong Harry untuk terus naik. “Satu lagi! Kita bisa! Ayo!”

f6ec32cc5ebd.en: “Yes, please!” Nodding, Harry followed after Sora. At the blue door, Harry spotted a mid-sized living quarters. To his right there were a few wooden bookshelves, dressers, and a couch where Sora stood by.
f6ec32cc5ebd.t: “Iya, tolong!” Sambil mengangguk, Harry mengikuti Sora. Di balik pintu biru, Harry melihat sebuah tempat tinggal berukuran sedang. Di sebelah kanannya ada beberapa rak buku kayu, lemari laci, dan sebuah sofa tempat Sora berdiri.

f79c64bc0a9b.en: The stranger placed his hands over his eyes and ears, trying to stop it all. His nose was still raped by the stench, but as the seconds passed, the stench no longer burned, but rather it just kept turning his stomach, with a slight nausea on the side. Meanwhile, stars popped and faded in his vision as a result of the troglodyte sneeze.
f79c64bc0a9b.t: Orang asing itu menutupi mata dan telinganya dengan tangan, berusaha menghentikan semuanya. Hidungnya masih diperkosa oleh bau itu, tetapi seiring detik-detik berlalu, bau itu tidak lagi membakar, melainkan hanya terus membuat perutnya mual, dengan sedikit rasa ingin muntah. Sementara itu, bintang-bintang bermunculan dan memudar di penglihatannya akibat bersin ala manusia gua itu.

f7f9d76cd26e.en: Chapter II subchapter 1: a heavy man in glasses and underwear slouches in an armchair in a dark room, with bottles and snacks.
f7f9d76cd26e.t: Bab II subbab 1: seorang pria gemuk berkacamata dan bercelana dalam bermalas-malasan di kursi berlengan di ruangan gelap, dengan botol-botol dan camilan.

f80831805772.en: Neferteri’s elegant demeanor grew wary as Nina interrupted what she was about to say.
f80831805772.t: Sikap anggun Neferteri berubah waspada saat Nina menyela apa yang hendak ia katakan.

f8ce60ae30f3.en: Harry’s ear picked up on the moan, while he felt her shiver in his hands; his brain immediately got swamped with an urge to rub his fingers all over her Darfaries veins, imagining the possibility of maybe licking it instead to see how she would react.
f8ce60ae30f3.t: Telinga Harry menangkap desahan itu, sementara ia merasakan gadis itu gemetar di tangannya; otaknya seketika dibanjiri dorongan untuk menggosokkan jari-jarinya ke seluruh urat Darfaries-nya, membayangkan kemungkinan menjilatinya saja untuk melihat bagaimana reaksinya.

f91dabeeede8.en: He remembered something painful—he had had a heart attack in that same chair, and fell to the floor as he tried to reach for his cellphone. The memory felt so real, as if it had just happened. He grabbed his heart, thinking he was still having a heart attack, but instead he felt a normal heartbeat, and a cold sauce that now laid on his chest. I’m alive? But I?—where’s the light?—wait? Isn’t this the living room?
f91dabeeede8.t: Ia teringat sesuatu yang menyakitkan—ia pernah terkena serangan jantung di kursi yang sama itu, dan jatuh ke lantai saat mencoba meraih ponselnya. Ingatan itu terasa begitu nyata, seolah baru saja terjadi. Ia mencengkeram jantungnya, mengira ia masih terkena serangan jantung, tetapi yang ia rasakan justru detak jantung yang normal, dan saus dingin yang kini menempel di dadanya. Aku hidup? Tapi aku?—di mana cahayanya?—tunggu? Bukankah ini ruang tamu?

f9981abaac8c.en: N-A-R-I—nari? Huh? What is this? The stranger, with both hands, accidentally split the nari chain in half. His lips thinned into a nervous grin, while his hands quickly placed them back where he found them.
f9981abaac8c.t: N-A-R-I—nari? Hah? Apa ini? Orang asing itu, dengan kedua tangannya, tanpa sengaja mematahkan rantai nari itu menjadi dua. Bibirnya menipis menjadi seringai gugup, sementara tangannya cepat-cepat menaruhnya kembali di tempat ia menemukannya.

fa828249f6fa.en: “Wait. What’s the difference between Darfaries and—Wo—Wozefaries?” Harry couldn’t stop looking at her sheer cuteness; her maid clothing revealed a bit of her breasts, but not enough to be scandalous.
fa828249f6fa.t: “Tunggu. Apa bedanya Darfaries dan—Wo—Wozefaries?” Harry tidak bisa berhenti memandangi keimutannya yang luar biasa; pakaian pelayannya sedikit memperlihatkan payudaranya, tetapi tidak sampai memalukan.

fe73e8fbfb08.en: Another memory that rose was of a place that looked like a cubicle farm. He knew he spent most of his time there, but he did not know why. Not that it mattered as it passed by, and disappeared into the darkness.
fe73e8fbfb08.t: Ingatan lain yang muncul adalah sebuah tempat yang tampak seperti deretan bilik kerja. Ia tahu ia menghabiskan sebagian besar waktunya di sana, tetapi ia tidak tahu kenapa. Toh itu tidak penting karena ingatan itu berlalu, dan menghilang ke dalam kegelapan.

feb410350706.en: Reaching the floor below, the floor setup was nearly the same, two main doors, one right in front of the stairs, and another to the side. Nothing special, but nothing familiar either.
feb410350706.t: Sampai di lantai bawah, susunannya hampir sama, dua pintu utama, satu tepat di depan tangga, dan satu lagi di samping. Tidak ada yang istimewa, tetapi tidak ada yang familier juga.

ff63ce6a55bd.en: Something caught his attention, he saw a green thingy that looked thin and pointy, like a weird pole weapon. Picking it up, he saw it was composed of multiple small green woody objects covering a diamond-like stone, with each woody thing containing a red line that zig-zagged in pseudo-squares, connecting to each other in the middle point of the left, and right borders.
ff63ce6a55bd.t: Sesuatu menarik perhatiannya, ia melihat benda hijau yang tampak tipis dan runcing, seperti senjata galah yang aneh. Memungutnya, ia melihat benda itu terdiri dari banyak benda kecil hijau seperti kayu yang membungkus batu mirip berlian, dengan setiap benda kayu itu memiliki garis merah yang berzig-zag membentuk kotak-kotak semu, saling terhubung di titik tengah tepi kiri dan kanannya.
